66268.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆明顯比周圍紅血球大的受感染紅血球，內含約 16–20 個分散的紫色小核（merozoite）與散在的金棕色瘧色素，且紅血球背景有淡粉紅色點狀（Schüffner stippling）；被感染紅血球變大加上多核裂殖體，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）裂殖體。
features: Single enlarged infected red cell (larger than surrounding red cells) containing a mature schizont
Approximately 16-20 discrete merozoites with dark purple chromatin dots and small cytoplasmic halos
Scattered golden-brown malarial pigment among the merozoites rather than a single central clump
Pale pinkish stippling of the host cell cytoplasm consistent with Schüffner dots
Background red cells normocytic with frequent crenated forms (echinocytes, likely artifact); no other parasite stages in field
66268.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear (Field's stain, oil immersion) shows a single enlarged erythrocyte containing a mature schizont with approximately 16 to 20 merozoites, scattered golden-brown pigment and faint Schüffner-type stippling. Surrounding red cells are normocytic with numerous echinocytes, likely a preparation artifact, and no ring forms or gametocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax schizont; parasitemia should be quantified and, where available, confirmed by antigen testing or PCR.

ddx.vs: P. ovale schizonts have fewer merozoites (6-14) in an oval, often fimbriated host cell, whereas this cell is round with about 16-20 merozoites.
P. malariae forms a 'rosette' of 6-12 merozoites around central pigment in a normal-sized or small red cell without stippling.
Falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood, occur in non-enlarged red cells with 8-24 small merozoites and a single dark pigment mass, typically with many accompanying ring forms.
Knowlesi schizonts resemble P. malariae in non-enlarged cells without Schüffner dots and require PCR for confirmation.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax schizont — enlarged red cell with ~16–20 merozoites, scattered golden-brown pigment and Schüffner stippling
pearls_zh: 考法：數 merozoite 並看宿主紅血球大小；受感染紅血球變大 + Schüffner dots + 12–24 個 merozoite，答 P. vivax schizont。
P. vivax 偏好感染 reticulocyte，故受感染細胞變大；可在各期寄生蟲同時出現於周邊血。
P. vivax 與 P. ovale 有肝內 hypnozoite，會復發；根治需加 primaquine 或 tafenoquine，用藥前必須檢查 G6PD（缺乏者溶血）。
Duffy 抗原陰性者傳統上對 vivax 較具抵抗力，但已有 Duffy-negative 感染報告。
台灣為境外移入個案，需通報；species 不確定時以 PCR 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. ovale schizont 混淆；ovale 紅血球常呈橢圓、邊緣鬚狀，merozoite 較少（約 6–14 個），vivax 紅血球圓且 merozoite 較多。

quiz.q: 此裂殖體最可能屬於哪一種瘧原蟲？根治治療前必須做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: P. vivax；G6PD 活性檢測（因需使用 primaquine/tafenoquine）。

65948.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆血小板大小與周圍紅血球相當，內部有大量紫色顆粒、邊緣不規則，是巨大血小板（giant platelet）；旁邊的正常血小板只有其幾分之一大小，可作為比例尺。
features: Central giant platelet approximately equal in diameter to adjacent red cells
Abundant purple granules distributed through the platelet with an irregular, slightly fringed outline
Scattered normal-sized small platelets nearby for comparison, plus a few moderately enlarged forms
No nucleus within the giant platelet
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; no leukocytes in this field
65948.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells. A giant platelet approximately the size of a red cell, with abundant granules and an irregular border, is present among smaller normal-sized platelets and a few moderately enlarged forms. No leukocytes are present in this field to evaluate for Döhle-like inclusions. Findings are consistent with giant platelets, which may be seen in inherited macrothrombocytopenias such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome or MYH9-related disorders, in myeloproliferative or myelodysplastic neoplasms, and in immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round nucleus with clumped chromatin and a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas the giant platelet is anucleate and granular.
Micromegakaryocytes contain a dense nucleus and fragments are larger with irregular cytoplasmic tags, neither of which is seen here.
A clump shows multiple overlapping platelets with separate outlines rather than a single continuous granular platelet.
Gray platelets are large but pale and agranular, while this giant platelet is heavily granulated.

exam.answer_en: Giant platelet — anucleate, heavily granulated platelet approximately the diameter of adjacent red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：以旁邊正常血小板與紅血球為比例尺，問中央結構名稱；答 giant platelet（大小接近或超過紅血球）。
鑑別方向：inherited macrothrombocytopenia（Bernard-Soulier、MYH9-related、gray platelet syndrome）、MPN/MDS、ITP。
Gray platelet syndrome 血小板大而淡灰無顆粒（缺 α granules，NBEAL2），本圖為顆粒豐富可排除。
巨大血小板多時，分析儀血小板數可能偽低；報告應附手工估計，並評估白血球包涵體（MYH9）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為小淋巴球或巨核細胞碎片；巨大血小板無核，micromegakaryocyte 則含有緻密細胞核。

quiz.q: 中央結構為何？若血小板大而顆粒缺乏、呈淡灰色，應考慮哪個疾病？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；gray platelet syndrome（α granule 缺乏，NBEAL2）。

66140.recognize_zh: 視野中有四顆大小相近的細胞，核呈 3–4 葉、染色質粗塊狀，葉間以細絲相連，胞質淡粉紅帶細小顆粒，這就是分節型嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）；胞質顆粒偏少，可能與 AML 背景下的發育不良有關。
features: Four neutrophils about twice the diameter of red cells, with 3–4 nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments
Coarsely clumped condensed chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine, sparse granules (possible mild hypogranularity)
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with some rouleaux-like stacking; scattered platelets present
66140.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several mature segmented neutrophils with three to four nuclear lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments, coarsely clumped chromatin and pale cytoplasm containing fine granules. Granulation appears somewhat sparse, although stain quality limits assessment of hypogranularity. No blasts or Auer rods are present in this field, and red cells show mild anisocytosis with focal stacking. Findings are consistent with segmented neutrophils; in a patient with AML, careful review for dysgranulopoiesis (hypogranularity, pseudo-Pelger-Huët nuclei) is warranted.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas these cells have three to four lobes.
Eosinophils typically have bilobed nuclei and coarse orange-red refractile granules filling the cytoplasm.
Dysplastic neutrophils show markedly agranular pale-gray cytoplasm or hypolobated pseudo-Pelger-Huët nuclei, which require a well-stained smear to judge.

65052.recognize_zh: 未染色的頭髮光學顯微鏡檢查：髮幹內的黑色素不是均勻細緻分布，而是聚成一段段深褐色、大小不一的團塊沿髮幹排列；配合巨大顆粒的白血球，就是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的毛髮表現。
features: Unstained hair shafts examined by light microscopy with mounting-medium air bubbles
Melanin aggregated into discrete dark brown clumps along the shaft rather than finely dispersed
Clumps are irregular in size and spacing, predominantly along the central shaft
Hair shaft cuticle and cortex otherwise intact without fractures or nodes
65052.describe_en: Light microscopy of unstained hair shafts shows abnormal aggregation of melanin into discrete dark brown clumps distributed along the length of the shafts, in contrast to the fine uniform pigment of normal hair. The clumps vary in size and spacing. The shafts are otherwise structurally intact, without trichorrhexis or other shaft defects. In a patient with giant granules in leukocytes, the findings are consistent with the pigmentary defect of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Griscelli syndrome shows larger, more irregular and unevenly spaced melanin clumps and lacks giant granules in leukocytes.
Elejalde syndrome has similar large pigment clumps but with neurologic disease and no giant leukocyte granules.
Normal hair has fine, evenly dispersed melanin granules without discrete clumps.

65628.recognize_zh: 胸椎矢狀 MRI 在 T6 背側見一顯影增強、壓迫脊髓的腫塊（箭頭）；手術切片卻不是造血組織，而是富含破骨細胞樣多核巨細胞（細箭頭）、梭形纖維母細胞基質、出血與反應性骨樣組織（粗箭頭），加上 USP6 重排，診斷為實質型動脈瘤樣骨囊腫，而非地中海貧血的髓外造血。
features: Sagittal contrast-enhanced MRI of thoracic spine: enhancing posterior epidural/paraspinal mass at T6 (arrow) compressing the spinal cord
H&E: cellular lesion with numerous scattered osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells (thin arrows)
Background bland spindle fibroblastic stroma with extravasated red cells/hemorrhage
Pink reactive osteoid/woven bone (thick arrow)
No trilineage hematopoietic elements (erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes, granulocytes) identified
65628.describe_en: Sagittal post-contrast MRI of the thoracic spine demonstrates an enhancing, cord-compressing mass centered at the posterior aspect of T6. The resected tissue shows a cellular proliferation of bland spindle fibroblastic cells with numerous scattered osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells, extravasated red cells and foci of reactive osteoid and woven bone. Trilineage hematopoiesis is not identified, arguing against extramedullary hematopoiesis. Immunostains for cytokeratin, EMA, GFAP and PR were negative, and FISH demonstrated USP6 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with solid variant aneurysmal bone cyst.

ddx.vs: EMH contains erythroid precursors, granulocytic cells and megakaryocytes with fat, rather than spindle stroma with osteoclast-like giant cells.
Giant cells are evenly distributed among mononuclear cells whose nuclei match the giant cell nuclei, with H3F3A G34W mutation rather than USP6 rearrangement.
Histology overlaps closely; elevated PTH and calcium with other bone changes separate it, and USP6 is not rearranged.
Shows markedly atypical, mitotically active stromal cells producing malignant osteoid, unlike the bland stroma here.

65500.recognize_zh: 淋巴結細針抽吸抹片中，可見多群圓形、大小不一的酵母菌體，每顆都有中央菌體與外圍透明、折光的厚莢膜暈，像一串泡泡；背景有少數淋巴細胞與組織球。成群的帶莢膜、大小不一酵母菌，應考慮 Cryptococcus。
features: Clusters of round to oval yeast forms of variable size
Each yeast has a central refractile body surrounded by a thick, clear capsular halo
Occasional budding forms within the clusters
Sparse background lymphocytes and a histiocyte in a proteinaceous, pink granular background
No hyphae or pseudohyphae identified
65500.describe_en: Fine-needle aspiration smear of an abdominal lymph node shows a proteinaceous background with sparse lymphocytes and occasional histiocytes. Several clusters of round yeast forms of variable size are present, each with a central body surrounded by a thick, clear refractile capsule; occasional budding is seen and no hyphae are identified. The stain is not specified in the image (pink H&E/Pap-type appearance). Findings are suggestive of cryptococcal infection; confirmation with mucicarmine or India ink preparation and serum/CSF cryptococcal antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small, uniform and predominantly intracellular within histiocytes without a thick capsule.
Blastomyces yeasts show a thick double-contoured wall with broad-based budding rather than narrow-based budding and a wide clear capsule.
Talaromyces yeasts are small, uniform, intracellular and divide by central septation (fission) rather than budding.
Lipid droplets and glove starch lack a central organism; starch shows a Maltese-cross pattern under polarized light.

65244.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，以左移的顆粒球前驅細胞與紅血球母細胞為主，部分前驅細胞細胞質可見小而清楚的空泡；在 UBA1 突變背景下，前驅細胞空泡是 VEXAS 的形態線索。
features: Cellular aspirate with abundant granulocytic precursors showing a left shift (promyelocytes, myelocytes)
Erythroid precursors including basophilic erythroblasts with deep blue cytoplasm
Scattered small, punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in some precursors
Mature neutrophils and bands with coarse granulation
No increase in blasts evident in this field
65244.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a left-shifted granulocytic series together with erythroid precursors, including basophilic erythroblasts. A subset of myeloid and erythroid precursors contains small punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, although vacuolization is focal in this field. Mature neutrophils show coarse granulation, and blasts are not increased. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the bone marrow changes of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Copper deficiency also causes vacuolated myeloid and erythroid precursors, but is distinguished by low serum copper and ceruloplasmin and lack of UBA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Alcohol or drug toxicity (e.g., linezolid, chloramphenicol)
ddx.vs: Toxin-related vacuolization is reversible with withdrawal and is not associated with a somatic UBA1 variant.
MDS can show dysplasia without precursor vacuoles and requires exclusion of UBA1 mutation, since VEXAS can coexist with or mimic MDS.
Infection-driven left shift lacks consistent precursor vacuolization in erythroid cells.

65372.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散布數顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、細胞質淡藍灰且四周有細毛狀突起，一片視野就看到多顆這種毛細胞，指向毛細胞白血病。
features: Several medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
No conspicuous nucleoli
An irregular purple aggregate at lower field, likely a platelet clump or smudged cell
Thick-area background with closely packed red cells
65372.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at moderate magnification shows several medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections. Nucleoli are not prominent. An irregular purple aggregate likely represents a platelet clump or smudged cell. Normal neutrophils and monocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometric confirmation (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells have a distinct central nucleolus and are CD25/ANXA1 negative with wild-type BRAF.
Villous lymphocytes show short polar villi, more condensed chromatin and sometimes plasmacytoid features, without CD103/CD123 co-expression.
LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and smooth borders rather than hairy projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — several circulating hairy cells with pale grey-blue cytoplasm and fine circumferential projections
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野多顆毛細胞且缺乏單核球，考官問 CBC 特徵：pancytopenia 合併 monocytopenia。
骨髓：抽吸常 dry tap（reticulin fibrosis）；切片呈「fried egg」外觀，細胞間距寬、核周透明。
IHC：annexin A1 為 HCL 最特異標記（SMZL 與 HCL variant 陰性），TRAP 陽性、cyclin D1 常弱陽性。
治療：purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin）± rituximab 為一線；復發可考慮 BRAF inhibitor（如 vemurafenib）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 視野中不規則紫色團塊可能是血小板團或破碎細胞，勿誤計為腫瘤細胞；毛細胞需核圓整、細胞質邊緣有細毛狀突起。

quiz.q: 此病 CBC 上除 pancytopenia 外，最具特徵的是哪種白血球減少？
quiz.a: Monocytopenia（單核球減少）

65180.recognize_zh: A–D 為一片小而成熟的淋巴球，CD20、CD5、CD23、LEF1 陽性，代表持續的 CLL/SLL；E 則是含壞死碎屑的區域，放大圖可見毛玻璃樣核、染色質邊聚與多核細胞，F 的 HSV-I/II 免疫染色陽性，確認為疱疹病毒淋巴結炎而非 Richter 轉化。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small, round, mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin effacing nodal architecture (A)
Neoplastic B cells CD20+, CD5+ (brighter than background, with scattered CD3+ T cells), CD23+ and nuclear LEF1+ (B-D)
Separate fragment with necrosis, karyorrhectic debris and inflammatory cells rather than sheets of large transformed cells (E)
Viral cytopathic effect: enlarged ground-glass nuclei, chromatin margination, nuclear molding and multinucleation (E inset)
Numerous cells with nuclear/cytoplasmic HSV-I/II immunoreactivity around the necrotic area (F)
65180.describe_en: Needle core biopsy of the inguinal lymph node shows effacement of the architecture by a diffuse infiltrate of small mature lymphocytes that express CD20, CD5, CD23 and LEF1, consistent with persistent CLL/SLL; no sheets of large cells are identified in these fields. A separate fragment shows necrosis with inflammatory debris, within which cells display ground-glass nuclei, chromatin margination and multinucleation. HSV-I/II immunostain highlights numerous infected cells. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis in a background of CLL/SLL, with no morphologic evidence of Richter transformation.

ddx.vs: Richter shows confluent sheets of large centroblast/immunoblast-like cells with tumor-type necrosis, not multinucleated ground-glass viral cells with HSV immunoreactivity.

ddx.dx: CLL/SLL with expanded proliferation centers (accelerated CLL)
ddx.vs: Accelerated CLL has broad, confluent proliferation centers of prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts with high Ki67 but lacks necrosis and viral inclusions.
CMV produces enlarged cells with single large owl-eye intranuclear plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions and is CMV IHC-positive, rather than molded multinucleated ground-glass nuclei.
Reed-Sternberg-like cells are CD30+/CD15+ with prominent macronucleoli and lack HSV staining.

65180.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD5, CD3, CD23, LEF1, HSV-I/II

65116.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央（箭頭）一顆巨大巨噬細胞，細胞質淡藍呈泡沫狀，內含許多被吞噬的紅血球與數顆深染的有核紅血球母細胞，符合噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Very large macrophage (arrow) with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Numerous engulfed intact red blood cells visible as pale grey round inclusions within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Several phagocytosed nucleated cells with dense round nuclei consistent with erythroblasts
Macrophage nucleus partly obscured by the ingested material
Adjacent intact erythroblasts and a granulocytic precursor in the background; red cells without notable abnormality
65116.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage (arrow) with abundant vacuolated, pale blue cytoplasm containing numerous phagocytosed red blood cells and several nucleated erythroid precursors with dense chromatin. Surrounding marrow elements include intact erythroblasts and granulocytic cells. The finding of active hemophagocytosis of red cells and erythroblasts is evident, although hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis in the clinical setting of macrophage activation syndrome (secondary HLH).

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytes are seen in many reactive states, so the diagnosis of HLH/MAS rests on clinical and laboratory criteria (ferritin, sCD25, cytopenias, fever) rather than this morphology alone.
A nurse macrophage is surrounded by attached maturing erythroblasts at its periphery, whereas here red cells and erythroblasts are enclosed within cytoplasmic vacuoles.
Neoplastic histiocytes show marked nuclear atypia and pleomorphism, whereas this macrophage appears cytologically bland apart from its phagocytic load.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — large bone marrow macrophage engulfing numerous red cells and erythroblasts (consistent with HLH context)
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處巨大細胞問是什麼、裡面吞了什麼；答 macrophage 吞噬 RBC 與 erythroblast（hemophagocytosis），並追問是否足以診斷 HLH。
HLH-2004 標準：分子診斷（如 PRF1、UNC13D、STX11、STXBP2）或 8 項中符合 5 項：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高 TG 和/或低 fibrinogen、噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 升高。
噬血現象既非必要也非充分：輸血、感染或敗血症也可見；需結合 ferritin、sCD25、fibrinogen、triglyceride 等實驗室數據判斷。
Primary HLH 多見於幼兒（familial HLH、X-linked lymphoproliferative disease 等），治療以 HLH-94 類方案（etoposide + dexamethasone）穩定後接 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把紅血球疊在巨噬細胞上（抹片重疊假象）當成吞噬；真正噬血時被吞物位於細胞質空泡內、被細胞膜包覆且與細胞同一焦平面。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指巨噬細胞細胞質內含許多紅血球與有核紅血球，這個現象叫什麼？單靠此發現能否診斷 HLH？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；不能，需符合 HLH-2004 標準（5/8 或分子診斷）。

64988.recognize_zh: 中央與右上方的漿細胞核偏位，細胞質深藍色並被許多大小一致、圓形淡灰藍的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies）塞滿，看起來像一串葡萄，這就是 Mott 細胞；周圍是正常成熟中的顆粒球系細胞。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse chromatin
Cytoplasm distended by multiple round, uniform, pale gray-blue globular inclusions (Russell bodies), giving a bunch-of-grapes appearance
Deeply basophilic cytoplasmic rim between the inclusions
Another plasma cell (upper right) with a perinuclear hof and fewer vacuole-like inclusions
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and red cells
64988.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows plasma cells with eccentric nuclei whose cytoplasm is filled with multiple round, pale, uniform globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, producing the characteristic Mott cell (morula cell) appearance. The background shows maturing granulocytic precursors and neutrophils without an obvious increase in atypical plasma cells in this field. Mott cells reflect accumulation of immunoglobulin in dilated rough endoplasmic reticulum and are not specific for malignancy. Findings are consistent with Mott cells; correlation with overall plasma cell percentage and clonality studies is needed to separate reactive plasmacytosis from a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell with cytoplasmic vacuolation (processing artifact)
ddx.vs: Artifactual vacuoles are clear and irregular in size, whereas Russell bodies are uniform, homogeneous, pale-staining globules filled with immunoglobulin.
Macrophages have a central bland nucleus without a hof and abundant pale foamy cytoplasm, and are CD68-positive, CD138-negative.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, rather than multiple cytoplasmic globules.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant granules in granulocytes, and Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than globular inclusions in plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Mott cells — plasma cells with cytoplasm distended by multiple uniform round Russell bodies (grape-like appearance)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央像一串葡萄的細胞問名稱，答 Mott cell（亦稱 grape cell、morula cell），並說出其中每顆圓球為 Russell body。
Russell body 為免疫球蛋白無法分泌而堆積於擴張的 rough ER，PAS 陽性；位於核上的假性核內包涵體則稱 Dutcher body。
Mott cell 非腫瘤特異：見於反應性漿細胞增生（慢性感染、發炎、自體免疫）、myeloma、lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma；Dutcher body 較支持腫瘤。
判斷良惡性需看漿細胞比例、型態不典型度與 kappa/lambda clonality，並配合 SPEP/immunofixation。
exam.pitfall_zh: Russell body 淡灰藍空泡樣外觀易被誤認為脂肪空泡、吞噬物（histiocyte）或 Chédiak-Higashi 巨大顆粒；Mott cell 仍保有偏心漿細胞核與深藍細胞質邊緣。

quiz.q: 中央細胞質內充滿圓形球狀包涵體、像一串葡萄的細胞叫什麼？這些包涵體的成分是什麼？
quiz.a: Mott cell；Russell bodies（堆積於 rough ER 的免疫球蛋白）。

64924.recognize_zh: 三格圖中的淋巴球都比正常小淋巴球大：A 為核凹陷的較小細胞，B 為胞質豐富、邊緣較藍並包繞紅血球的細胞，C 為核質疏鬆、胞質深藍的母細胞樣細胞，分別對應 Downey I、II、III 型反應性淋巴球，符合傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Panel A: medium-sized lymphocyte with indented, reniform nucleus and moderate pale cytoplasm (Downey type I)
Panel B: large lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia and scalloping around adjacent red cells (Downey type II)
Panel C: large blast-like lymphocyte with more open chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (Downey type III)
Heterogeneous spectrum of reactive lymphocyte morphology rather than a monotonous population
Background red cells show crenation artifact; platelets present
64924.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis with a heterogeneous population of reactive (atypical) lymphocytes. Forms range from medium-sized cells with indented nuclei (type I), to large cells with abundant cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia that indents around neighboring erythrocytes (type II), to large immunoblastic cells with more dispersed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (type III). Red cells show crenation artifact and platelets are present. The spectrum of morphology favors a reactive process; findings are consistent with infectious mononucleosis in the appropriate clinical and serologic setting.

ddx.vs: ALL shows a monotonous population of blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, not a spectrum of reactive forms with abundant scalloping cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Other viral reactive lymphocytosis (CMV, acute HIV, hepatitis)
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; heterophile and EBV-specific serology or viral testing is required.

ddx.dx: T-cell or B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Neoplastic cells are more monomorphic with nuclear irregularity, and flow cytometry shows clonality or aberrant antigen loss.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm without the peripheral basophilia that hugs red cells.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis — heterogeneous reactive lymphocytes (Downey types I–III) with cytoplasm scalloping around red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：三格分別指出 Downey I、II、III 型；II 型「胞質邊緣變藍並包住紅血球」是最經典的考點。
EBV 感染的反應性淋巴球主要是活化的 CD8+ T cell，並非被感染的 B cell。
確診：heterophile antibody（Monospot）陽性；早期或兒童可偽陰性，需驗 EBV VCA IgM。heterophile 陰性時考慮 CMV、急性 HIV、toxoplasmosis。
臨床：脾腫大者數週內避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂；給 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹。
與白血病的關鍵區分：反應性淋巴球是「形態多樣的光譜」，腫瘤細胞則是單調一致的族群。
exam.pitfall_zh: Downey III 型（免疫母細胞樣）易被誤認為 blast 或淋巴瘤細胞：反應性病程中同片可見 I–III 型連續光譜，且 flow 無 clonality；ALL 則為單調 blast。

quiz.q: B 格中細胞質邊緣偏藍、包繞鄰近紅血球的淋巴球屬 Downey 哪一型？此類細胞主要是哪種淋巴球？
quiz.a: Downey type II；活化的 CD8+ T cell。

64796.recognize_zh: 組合圖上方為先前 Burkitt 淋巴瘤：中型細胞、深藍色細胞質內含多個清楚脂質空泡，並有 t(8;14)；中間 D 格則是兩年後出現的大型異型組織球樣細胞，核扭曲或多核、細胞質豐富多空泡並有吞噬現象，切片 S100+、CD68+、CD1a−，加上 IGH 相同克隆峰，代表轉分化而來的組織球肉瘤。
features: Panel A: cohesive-appearing sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles (Burkitt lymphoma)
Panel D: large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated, foamy grey-blue cytoplasm, contoured to lobulated or multiple nuclei, fine chromatin and nucleoli, some with phagocytosed cells
Panel E: HES section with sheets of large pleomorphic cells; S100 and CD68 positive, CD1a negative
Panels B/F: karyotypes showing t(8;14) and later a complex karyotype; panel G FISH IGH and MYC break-apart signals
Panel C: PET-CT with hypermetabolic lytic pelvic/sacroiliac lesions; panel H identical clonal IGH peaks in lymphoma and sarcoma
64796.describe_en: Initial bone marrow aspirate (A) shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and numerous discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, with a t(8;14) karyotype (B), consistent with Burkitt lymphoma. A later aspirate from a lytic iliac lesion (C-D) shows large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated, foamy cytoplasm, irregular to multilobated or multiple nuclei with nucleoli, and occasional hemophagocytosis. The corresponding biopsy (E) shows sheets of large pleomorphic cells that are S100 and CD68 positive and CD1a negative. Persistence of MYC::IGH rearrangement and an identical clonal IGH rearrangement (F-H) indicate a clonally related neoplasm; findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma arising by transdifferentiation from prior Burkitt lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Relapse would show monotonous medium-sized CD20+/CD10+ cells with vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, not large pleomorphic S100+/CD68+ histiocytic cells lacking B-cell markers.
Langerhans cell neoplasms have grooved nuclei and are CD1a+ and langerin+, whereas these cells are CD1a-negative.
Reactive histiocytes are cytologically bland with small nuclei and are polyclonal, while these cells are atypical with nucleoli and share the lymphoma's clonal IGH and MYC rearrangements.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or metastatic carcinoma/melanoma
ddx.vs: ALCL is CD30+ with T-cell markers, carcinoma is keratin+, and melanoma is S100+ but also SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A+ and CD68-negative.

64796.stain: MGG, HES, IHC: S100, CD68, CD1a; FISH; karyotype

64668.recognize_zh: 左圖三分葉嗜酸性球、右圖圓核的嗜酸性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocyte），細胞質內同時混有深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒與橘色嗜酸性顆粒，這種雙色混雜的顆粒就是 harlequin cell 的線索。
features: Left: mature eosinophil with trilobed nucleus and clumped chromatin
Right: larger eosinophilic myelocyte with round, non-lobulated nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Mixed granule population: dark purple-black basophilic granules admixed with pale orange eosinophilic granules
Orange granules overlie the nucleus in the myelocyte; bluish cytoplasmic background
Uneven granule distribution with partially clear cytoplasmic areas in the mature cell
Background red cells without specific abnormality
64668.describe_en: Two high-power fields from a May-Grunwald-Giemsa stained smear show eosinophil-lineage cells with abnormal granulation. The left cell is a trilobed eosinophil containing an admixture of dark basophilic-appearing and orange eosinophilic granules. The right cell is an eosinophilic myelocyte with a round nucleus and cytoplasm packed with pale orange granules intermixed with coarse dark purple granules. Findings are consistent with dysplastic eosinophils with mixed (harlequin) granulation, as seen in myeloid neoplasms with eosinophilia.

ddx.vs: Immature eosinophil granules can appear bluish-purple in early myelocytes, but a mature lobulated eosinophil should not retain coarse dark basophilic granules.
Basophils have uniformly large dark granules obscuring the nucleus without an admixed population of orange eosinophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophils in AML with inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11
ddx.vs: In inv(16) AML the abnormal eosinophils are marrow precursors with large purple-violet granules accompanied by increased myelomonocytic blasts; genetic testing separates the entities.

64540.recognize_zh: 淋巴結粗針切片中，淋巴組織之間有成群的有核紅血球、骨髓系前驅細胞與多核的巨核細胞，免疫染色 CD61 標出巨核細胞、E-cadherin 標出紅血球系、MPO 標出骨髓系，這是淋巴結內的髓外造血。
features: Panel A: core biopsy of lymph node with lymphoid nodules separated by pale interstitial areas
Panel B: cohesive clusters of small round erythroid precursors with dense nuclei, admixed myeloid precursors, and a megakaryocyte
Panel C: CD61 highlights scattered megakaryocytes
Panel D: E-cadherin highlights membranous staining in clusters of erythroid precursors
Panel E: MPO highlights myeloid precursors
No sheets of atypical lymphoid cells; cytoplasmic vacuoles are not appreciable at this magnification
64540.describe_en: Core biopsy of a retroperitoneal lymph node shows lymphoid tissue with intervening islands of trilineage hematopoietic cells (panels A and B). The islands contain clusters of erythroid precursors, myeloid precursors, and occasional megakaryocytes, confirmed by E-cadherin, MPO, and CD61 immunostains, respectively (panels C–E). There is no morphologic evidence of a lymphoproliferative disorder or infiltrating carcinoma. Findings are consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis involving lymph node, which in this patient with a UBA1 mutation is attributed to VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma consists of sheets of immature blasts (CD34/CD117/MPO positive) rather than orderly maturing trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands.
Carcinoma forms cohesive cytokeratin-positive clusters, whereas these E-cadherin-positive clusters are small erythroid precursors lacking keratin.
Megakaryocytes can mimic Reed-Sternberg cells, but they are CD61 positive and CD30/CD15 negative and accompany erythroid and myeloid precursors.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary hematopoiesis due to primary myelofibrosis or thalassemia
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so separation requires marrow fibrosis assessment, JAK2/CALR/MPL or hemoglobin studies, and UBA1 testing.

64220.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中小型成熟淋巴球明顯增加，夾雜細胞質較多、核偏位的類漿細胞淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocytes）與具核周淡染區的漿細胞，呈連續成熟光譜，提示淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Increased small mature lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof, and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Spectrum of small lymphocyte to plasma cell differentiation without blasts
Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking; one large oval cell with coarse stippled appearance (possibly a mast cell or smudged nucleus) at upper right
64220.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in small mature lymphocytes admixed with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mature plasma cells, forming a continuous spectrum of lymphoplasmacytic differentiation. The lymphocytes have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, while plasmacytoid forms show eccentric nuclei with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm. No increase in blasts is identified, and background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking. Findings are suggestive of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate context of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation; mast cells, if increased, would further support this.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows monocytoid cells with more abundant pale cytoplasm and usually lacks MYD88 L265P, which is present in over 90% of LPL.
CLL cells have soccer-ball chromatin with smudge cells, are CD5+/CD23+, and do not show a distinct plasma cell component.
Myeloma consists of a clonal plasma cell population without an accompanying clonal B-lymphocyte component and is typically CD19-/CD45- with t(11;14) in IgM cases.
Reactive infiltrates contain polytypic plasma cells and B cells on flow cytometry or kappa/lambda ISH.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma — marrow small lymphocytes with a spectrum of plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：問這群小淋巴球、類漿細胞淋巴球與漿細胞連續光譜代表什麼；答 lymphoplasmacytic differentiation，配 IgM paraprotein 即 Waldenström macroglobulinemia。
分子：MYD88 L265P 見於 >90% LPL/WM；CXCR4 突變約三成至四成，與 BTK inhibitor 反應較慢或較差相關。
表型：B 細胞 CD19+、CD20+，通常 CD5−、CD10−；漿細胞 CD138+ 且與 B 細胞同一 light chain；骨髓常見 mast cells 增加與 Dutcher bodies。
臨床急症：IgM 造成 hyperviscosity（視力模糊、出血、神經症狀）需緊急 plasmapheresis；另注意 cryoglobulin、cold agglutinin、anti-MAG neuropathy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation：兩者形態重疊，靠 MYD88 L265P（MZL 少見）、臨床 IgM 與病灶分布區分；IgM myeloma 則為 MYD88 野生型、常有 t(11;14)。

quiz.q: 此骨髓淋巴球—類漿細胞淋巴球—漿細胞光譜，最常合併哪個突變？
quiz.a: MYD88 L265P（LPL/Waldenström macroglobulinemia）。

64156.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一群中等大小的母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、部分核有凹陷或摺痕，只有少量藍色細胞質（其中一顆帶小空泡），且未見 Auer 小體；這種形態符合淋巴母細胞，需以流式細胞儀確認 T 細胞系（T-ALL）。
features: Medium-sized blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Finely dispersed to slightly stippled chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Nuclear indentations and folded/convoluted contours in several blasts
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods or granules
Background red cells in thick area; strong blue color cast of the image
64156.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts show nuclear indentation or convolution, and one contains small cytoplasmic vacuoles; Auer rods are not identified. The image has a blue color cast, which limits assessment of cytoplasmic tint. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts; flow cytometry demonstrating cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT is needed to confirm T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable; lineage requires flow cytometry (CD19/CD79a/CD22 versus cytoplasmic CD3).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may have Auer rods, granules, or more cytoplasm and are MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117-positive, but morphology alone cannot exclude AML-M0.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous prominent vacuoles and are TdT-negative with MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma (blastoid)
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with cyclin D1 expression.

64092.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球大小不一、形狀極度多樣：大量橢圓形紅血球（elliptocyte）夾雜碎片紅血球、出芽狀與不規則小碎片（microspherocyte/fragment），明顯超出一般遺傳性橢圓紅血球症的程度，符合遺傳性熱變性異形紅血球症（HPP）。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous elliptocytes and ovalocytes
Frequent fragmented red cells, budding forms and irregular small fragments/microspherocytes
Many red cells appear small, consistent with microcytosis (MCV 68)
Scattered platelets; single neutrophil at lower right
No sickle cells, target cells predominance or parasites identified
64092.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous elliptocytes and ovalocytes admixed with many fragmented red cells, budding forms and small dense fragments/microspherocytes, and the red cells are overall small. Platelets are present, and the single neutrophil in the field is unremarkable; no schistocyte-associated thrombocytopenia or parasites are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a severe red cell membrane disorder, and together with the SPTA1 pathogenic variant are consistent with hereditary pyropoikilocytosis.

ddx.vs: Common HE shows mostly uniform elliptocytes with little fragmentation or microspherocytosis, whereas HPP shows marked fragments, budding and microcytosis.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet cells) with thrombocytopenia and an acute clinical picture rather than a background of numerous elliptocytes in a chronically anemic healthy patient.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency anemia with pencil cells
ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with elongated pencil cells but not the fragmentation and budding of HPP, and iron studies are abnormal.
Burns produce similar microspherocytes and budding fragments acutely, separated by clinical history and absence of a membrane gene variant.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary pyropoikilocytosis (SPTA1) — marked poikilocytosis with elliptocytes, fragments, budding forms and microspherocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：給嬰幼兒嚴重溶血、極低 MCV 與此抹片，問診斷；答 hereditary pyropoikilocytosis（HPP），屬 hereditary elliptocytosis 的嚴重型。
遺傳：多為 α-spectrin（SPTA1）缺陷，常為雙等位（例如一個 HE 突變合併低表現 allele 如 αLELY）；父母之一常為輕微 HE 或無症狀帶因者。
實驗室：MCV 可極低、RDW 高；EMA binding flow 降低（與 HS 同樣降低）；傳統上紅血球對熱敏感，在較低溫度即碎裂。
治療以支持性輸血與葉酸為主，嚴重輸血依賴者考慮脾臟切除（需注意感染與血栓風險並完成疫苗接種）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 schistocytes 為主的 TMA（TTP/HUS）或燒燙傷後紅血球碎裂：本圖血小板存在、背景有大量 elliptocytes，且為先天慢性病程；TMA 需伴血小板低下與急性臨床表現。

quiz.q: 嬰兒嚴重溶血、MCV 很低，抹片見 elliptocytes 合併大量碎片與 microspherocytes，最可能診斷與致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Hereditary pyropoikilocytosis；SPTA1（α-spectrin）。

64028.recognize_zh: 流式圖中 CD45 dim 族群分成 CD34 陰性（紫色）與 CD34 陽性（綠色）兩群，紫色群 CD38/CD138 強陽性且胞質 kappa 單株限制，卻同時表現 CD33、CD56、CD117，易被誤認為芽細胞；切片 CD138 大片陽性證實為漿細胞瘤。
features: Flow: CD45-dim population split into CD34-negative (purple) and CD34-positive myeloblast (green) subsets
Purple population is CD38 bright/CD138 positive with cytoplasmic kappa light-chain restriction
Aberrant CD56 and CD117 (dim) on plasma cells, overlapping with CD117+ myeloblasts
Plasma cells are CD33 positive but CD13 negative, whereas myeloblasts are CD13+/CD33+
H&E (G): hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei
CD138 IHC (H): diffuse membranous staining of the infiltrate
64028.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow identifies a CD45-dim, low side scatter population that is CD34 negative and distinct from a CD34-positive myeloblast population. The CD34-negative cells are CD38 bright and CD138 positive with cytoplasmic kappa light-chain restriction, and aberrantly express CD56, CD117 (dim), and CD33 while lacking CD13. The core biopsy shows diffuse infiltration by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, confirmed by diffuse CD138 immunostaining. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with aberrant CD33, CD56, and CD117 expression, a phenotype that can mimic myeloblasts if CD38/CD138 and light chains are not assessed.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are CD34+ and/or CD13+/CD33+ without bright CD38/CD138 or cytoplasmic light-chain restriction, and appear as blasts rather than plasma cells on the biopsy.
PBL has large immunoblastic cells, is often EBV/EBER positive and extramedullary, and lacks the CRAB-featured diffuse marrow myeloma picture.
Reactive plasma cells are CD19+/CD56- with polytypic kappa/lambda expression, unlike this light-chain-restricted CD56+ population.
Mast cells are CD117 bright with high side scatter and CD25/CD2 expression and lack CD138/cytoplasmic immunoglobulin.

63772.recognize_zh: 這是 PET 的最大強度投影（MIP）影像，不是形態學：左頸部成串融合的高代謝淋巴結，加上縱膈、腋下/胸大肌下、腹部與骨盆腔多處圓形高代謝灶，以及軀幹骨的點狀病灶，呈廣泛多站淋巴結與骨髓侵犯分布。
features: Coronal FDG PET maximum-intensity projection with arms raised
Chain of large, confluent hypermetabolic nodes along the left cervical region
Multiple hypermetabolic foci in bilateral axillary/subpectoral, mediastinal and retroperitoneal-abdominal regions
Scattered small foci projecting over ribs, spine and pelvis suggestive of skeletal/marrow involvement
Physiologic intense brain uptake and mild diffuse hepatic/splenic activity
63772.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic radiology image, a coronal maximum-intensity projection from an FDG PET study. There are numerous hypermetabolic lesions, including a confluent chain of left cervical lymph nodes, bilateral axillary/subpectoral nodes, mediastinal nodes and extensive abdominal and pelvic nodal masses, with additional smaller foci projecting over the skeleton. Physiologic brain uptake is noted. The pattern indicates widespread FDG-avid nodal and probable marrow disease, which is nonspecific between disseminated granulomatous infection and lymphoma; in this case, biopsy showed granulomas with acid-fast bacilli consistent with tuberculosis.

ddx.vs: PET distribution can be indistinguishable, so excisional nodal biopsy showing lymphoma cells rather than necrotizing granulomas with acid-fast bacilli is required.
Sarcoidosis typically shows symmetric hilar-mediastinal uptake with non-necrotizing granulomas and negative mycobacterial studies.
Metastatic disease usually has an identifiable FDG-avid primary, and biopsy shows keratin-positive epithelial cells.

ddx.dx: Histiocytic disorders (e.g. Rosai-Dorfman or Langerhans cell histiocytosis)
ddx.vs: These show characteristic S100/CD1a-positive histiocytes on biopsy rather than epithelioid granulomas with mycobacteria.

63964.recognize_zh: 四格中可見大型芽細胞，細胞質豐富灰藍至深藍、核圓或有凹陷；C 與 D 格芽細胞的細胞質內含被吞噬的紅血球（空泡中淡紅色圓盤），即芽細胞紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis），這是 AML 伴 t(8;16)(KAT6A::CREBBP) 的形態線索。
features: Large blasts with abundant gray-blue to basophilic cytoplasm and moderate N:C ratio (A-D)
Round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli; monocytoid folding in some cells
Engulfed red cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles of blasts (erythrophagocytosis), clearest in C and D
Panel A: cluster of blasts with admixed cells showing fine azurophilic granulation and a clear vacuole
Background red cells show small punctate dark-red dots overlying them (B, D), likely preparation artifact
63964.describe_en: This four-panel composite of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue to basophilic cytoplasm and round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli, with some monocytoid features and occasional fine azurophilic granules. Several blasts contain phagocytosed red cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles, best seen in panels C and D. Background red cells show punctate dark dots that are likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelomonocytic differentiation and blast erythrophagocytosis, a feature suggestive of AML with t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3); KAT6A::CREBBP, which is confirmed here by karyotype.

ddx.vs: In HLH the phagocytes are mature benign macrophages with low N:C ratio and condensed chromatin, not immature blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) or other monocytic AML with erythrophagocytosis
ddx.vs: Erythrophagocytosis is not entirely specific, so cytogenetic confirmation of t(8;16) versus MECOM or KMT2A rearrangement is required.
PCH granules are dense homogeneous salmon-pink globules, whereas phagocytosed red cells retain biconcave disc outlines within a clear vacuole.
APL can also cause DIC but shows hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA, not monocytoid erythrophagocytic blasts.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3) KAT6A::CREBBP — myelomonocytic blasts showing erythrophagocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指著胞質內含紅血球的芽細胞，問現象與相關轉位；答 blast erythrophagocytosis，典型連結 t(8;16) KAT6A::CREBBP。
臨床特徵：常有 DIC、皮膚等髓外浸潤，部分為 therapy-related；新生兒/嬰兒病例有自發緩解的報告，成人整體預後差。
芽細胞吞噬紅血球不等於 HLH：須由芽細胞本身吞噬，且芽細胞比例增加；HLH 的吞噬細胞是成熟巨噬細胞。
此型芽細胞為單核/骨髓單核分化，細胞化學可呈 MPO 與 NSE 皆陽性；確診需 karyotype、FISH 或 RNA fusion 檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 HLH 的噬血現象；HLH 由成熟巨噬細胞（胞質豐富、核小）吞噬，此處吞噬者是核染色質細緻、有核仁的芽細胞，背景芽細胞增加。

quiz.q: C、D 格芽細胞胞質內的圓形淡紅結構代表什麼現象？此現象最典型相關的 AML 融合基因為何？
quiz.a: 芽細胞吞噬紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）；KAT6A::CREBBP，t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3)

63708.recognize_zh: 這是 IGV 基因體瀏覽器截圖，位置在第 5 號染色體 NPM1 基因末端外顯子，許多定序讀段在同一位置出現紫色「I」插入標記（Insertion 4 bases: TAGG），代表 NPM1 的 4 個鹼基插入造成移碼突變，不是形態學影像。
features: Integrative Genomics Viewer display of chr5:170,837,526-170,837,566 (41 bp window) within NPM1
Purple 'I' insertion markers stacked at the same genomic position in a large subset of aligned reads
Tooltip identifies a 4-base insertion (TAGG) at the codon W288 region of the reference amino acid track
Remaining reads show wild-type sequence, consistent with a heterozygous somatic variant
Scattered isolated single-read mismatches elsewhere represent sequencing noise
63708.describe_en: This figure is a visualization of next-generation sequencing data from formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue in the Integrative Genomics Viewer, centered on the 3' coding region of NPM1 on chromosome 5q35. A recurrent 4-base-pair insertion (TAGG) is present at the same position in a substantial fraction of reads, adjacent to the tryptophan 288 codon, with the remaining reads showing reference sequence. Such exon 12 frameshift insertions alter the C-terminus of nucleophosmin, disrupting the nucleolar localization signal and creating a nuclear export signal, resulting in aberrant cytoplasmic localization. Findings are consistent with a pathogenic NPM1 mutation, which in this context supports classification as myeloid sarcoma/AML with mutated NPM1.

ddx.vs: Artifacts appear as isolated low-frequency or strand-biased events, whereas this insertion is recurrent at an identical position across many independent reads.
Pathogenic NPM1 exon 12 insertions are somatic, and a variant allele frequency well below 50% together with absence in non-tumor tissue supports a somatic event.

ddx.dx: Other NPM1 insertion types (type A TCTG duplication)
ddx.vs: Different exon 12 4-bp insertions (types A, B, D) share the same frameshift consequence and are separated only by the inserted sequence, not by clinical behavior.

63644.recognize_zh: 箭頭標出細長兩端尖的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cell）、細胞邊緣有透明泡狀缺口的水泡／咬痕細胞（blister/bite cell），以及數顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），背景白血球數量偏多，符合鐮刀型血紅素病合併氧化溶血的表現。
features: Occasional elongated sickle cell with tapered ends (arrow)
Blister/bite cell with a clear peripheral hemoglobin-free zone (arrow)
Several nucleated red blood cells with condensed nuclei (arrows)
Many segmented neutrophils in the field, suggesting leukocytosis
Anisopoikilocytosis with polychromatic cells and scattered small dense red cells
63644.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with scattered sickle cells, blister/bite cells with eccentric clear hemoglobin-free zones, and polychromatic red cells. Several nucleated red blood cells are present, and neutrophils appear increased in number. Findings are consistent with a sickling hemoglobinopathy with superimposed oxidative-type hemolysis; the blister/bite cells raise the possibility of coexisting G6PD deficiency or oxidant exposure, and correlation with hemoglobin fractionation and G6PD assay is recommended.

ddx.vs: G6PD deficiency shows bite/blister cells and Heinz bodies but no sickle cells, with normal hemoglobin electrophoresis.
HbSC shows crystal-containing cells and many target cells with fewer classic sickle forms, and HbC on electrophoresis.
Elliptocytes have blunt rounded ends and lack the pointed crescent shape of sickle cells.
MAHA shows helmet cells and schistocytes with sharp angular fragments rather than cells with a preserved outline and a peripheral blister.

63516.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 高倍下，箭頭所指紅血球內有一顆極小的深色點狀構造，被解讀為紅血球內的巴貝西蟲（Babesia）滋養體；背景為造血細胞與溶解的紅血球。H&E 下很難辨認，需以抹片確認。
features: Hypercellular marrow with mixed maturing myeloid, erythroid precursors, and a megakaryocyte-like large cell
Tiny dark basophilic dot within a red cell in a sinusoidal/interstitial area (arrow)
Parasite morphology (ring, tetrad) cannot be resolved on H&E
Pools of eosinophilic extravasated red cells and scattered brown pigment granules
Occasional eosinophil and band neutrophils in background
63516.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section stained with H&E shows a cellular marrow with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis and pools of red cells. A minute basophilic dot is present within an erythrocyte (arrow), interpreted in context as an intraerythrocytic Babesia trophozoite. Parasite morphology cannot be characterized on tissue sections, and the finding is subtle and nonspecific in isolation. Findings are suggestive of babesiosis only when correlated with the aspirate or peripheral smear, where intraerythrocytic parasites are readily identified, and with PCR.

ddx.vs: Plasmodium-infected red cells in tissue often contain brown-black hemozoin pigment and the species is resolved on thin smears, whereas Babesia lacks pigment.
Red cell inclusions are indistinguishable on H&E, so a Wright-stained smear showing a ring with cytoplasm versus a solid dot is needed.

ddx.dx: Platelet or debris overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Superimposed debris lies outside the cell in a different plane and is not reproduced within red cells on smear review.
These organisms are found inside macrophages, not red cells, and are larger with a visible halo or kinetoplast.

63388.recognize_zh: 這是尿沉渣自動影像分析儀擷取的單一灰階影像（Class 2 #77），比例尺 12.5 µm；可見一個約紅血球大小、兩端尖細的彎月形物體，外形類似鐮刀形紅血球，但解析度低，無法單憑此圖確認。
features: Grayscale digital sediment image from an automated urine analyzer (Class 2, particle #77) with a 12.5 um scale bar
Single crescent/sickle-shaped particle roughly 7-9 um long with tapered ends
Homogeneous content without visible internal structure or nucleus
No surrounding cells or casts for comparison
Low resolution and unstained imaging limit definitive identification
63388.describe_en: Automated urine sediment digital imaging shows a single unstained particle measuring approximately 7-9 um with a crescentic shape and tapered ends, classified by the analyzer into a red cell-related class. The morphology resembles a sickled red cell, but the low resolution and absence of internal detail prevent definitive distinction from a folded or crenated red cell or other debris. Findings are suggestive of sickled red cells in urine in a patient with sickle cell disease and should be verified by manual microscopy of the sediment.

ddx.vs: Folded red cells show a double contour or central fold line and variable shape on focusing, whereas sickle cells have tapered crescentic ends; manual phase-contrast review is needed.
Yeasts are oval, refractile and show budding, while pseudohyphae are longer segmented structures rather than a single crescent.
Mucus and debris are irregular, variably sized and lack the uniform red cell-sized volume of a sickled cell.

63324.recognize_zh: 中央一個組織球（histiocyte）胞質豐富且有許多空泡，裡面吞著一個核深染的有核細胞（形似紅血球前驅細胞或淋巴球）與吞噬碎屑，自身的核被推向一側；這是骨髓抹片中的血球吞噬（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Histiocyte with abundant pale blue, extensively vacuolated cytoplasm
Own nucleus with open chromatin displaced to one side
Engulfed nucleated cell with dense round nucleus within a phagocytic vacuole
Additional vacuoles containing pink phagocytosed debris
Background hemodilute aspirate with neutrophils, lymphocytes, nucleated red cells and an immature myeloid cell
63324.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, relatively hemodilute, shows neutrophils, lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and occasional immature myeloid cells. A histiocyte with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm contains an engulfed nucleated cell with a dense round nucleus and additional vacuoles with pink phagocytosed material. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; as an isolated rare finding it is nonspecific and should be correlated with clinical and laboratory criteria for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: In emperipolesis intact cells lie within cytoplasm (typically megakaryocytes) without phagocytic vacuoles or degeneration.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage with apoptotic debris
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain irregular pyknotic nuclear fragments rather than a recognizable intact engulfed cell.
Tumor cells are cohesive with atypical nuclei and prominent nucleoli rather than bland histiocytic nuclei.

63068.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞極多，以大量未成熟顆粒球系細胞為主，其中不少大細胞核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性並帶少量嗜天青顆粒（原始細胞／前骨髓細胞），同時仍可見各階段成熟嗜中性球；在 BCR-ABL1 陽性背景下，原始細胞增加（≥20%）即為 CML 急變期（blast phase）。
features: Markedly hypercellular smear dominated by immature granulocytic cells
Numerous large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei and fine, open chromatin
Many blasts and promyelocytes contain fine azurophilic granules in basophilic cytoplasm
Persistent maturing myeloid cells: myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional eosinophilic precursors; scattered nucleated red cells and small lymphocytes
No Auer rods clearly identifiable at this magnification
63068.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular with granulocytic hyperplasia. There is a prominent population of large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, many containing fine azurophilic granules, admixed with promyelocytes, myelocytes and maturing band and segmented neutrophils. Occasional eosinophilic precursors are present. Auer rods are not clearly seen. In a patient with BCR-ABL1 positivity and a reported blast count of 23%, the findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in myeloid blast phase.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase shows the full spectrum of granulocytic maturation with a myelocyte peak and blasts well below 20% (and <10% in the WHO 2016 accelerated-phase framework), not the expanded blast population seen here.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with BCR-ABL1 (de novo)
ddx.vs: De novo BCR-ABL1+ AML lacks a preceding CML history, basophilia and marked granulocytic hyperplasia with maturation, and usually shows the p190 rather than p210 transcript; morphology alone cannot separate them.
APL shows a monotonous population of heavily granulated abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells, little maturation to segmented neutrophils, and PML-RARA rather than BCR-ABL1.
Lymphoid blasts are agranular with scant cytoplasm and express TdT/CD19/CD10 on flow cytometry, whereas the blasts here are granular and myeloid-appearing.

exam.answer_en: CML, myeloid blast phase — expanded myeloid blast population (reported 23%) on a BCR::ABL1-positive granulocytic background
pearls_zh: 考法：在 CML 背景（各階段成熟顆粒球）中指高 N:C 比大細胞問「芽細胞」，再問急變期定義，以及用 flow 區分髓系或淋巴系急變。
WHO 5th 取消 accelerated phase，只分 chronic 與 blast phase：芽細胞 ≥20%、髓外芽細胞增生，或周邊血/骨髓出現增加的 lymphoblasts；ICC 2022 仍保留 AP。
系別：多數為髓系急變，約 20–30% 為淋巴系（多為 B-lymphoblast，TdT/CD19/CD10+）；系別決定合併的化療方案。
急變常伴額外細胞遺傳異常（+8、額外 Ph、i(17q)、+19）與 ABL1 kinase domain 突變；T315I 對多數 TKI 抗藥，ponatinib 或 asciminib 有效。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 APL 或 de novo AML with BCR::ABL1 混淆；CML-BP 有 CML 病史、嗜鹼性球增多並保留成熟顆粒球，APL 為單一異常前骨髓細胞並帶 PML::RARA。

quiz.q: 依 WHO 5th，CML 病人骨髓或周邊血芽細胞比例達多少即可診斷 blast phase？

63260.recognize_zh: 油鏡下一個淋巴樣細胞，核圓稍凹、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡藍色且在一側含兩顆粗大、圓形的紅色嗜天青顆粒；背景紅血球輕度大小不等並有淚滴形與不規則形紅血球；粗大顆粒的淋巴球提示大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）增生，符合 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cell with round to slightly indented nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleolus not seen
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of pale blue cytoplasm, broader on one side
Two coarse, round, red-pink azurophilic granules clustered at the cytoplasmic edge (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi-like)
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including teardrop and irregular/fragmented forms
Small platelets scattered in the background
63260.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a lymphoid cell with a round to slightly indented nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing two coarse, round, red-pink azurophilic granules. These granules are larger than typical LGL granules and resemble pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and irregular forms, and platelets are present. With a supporting clonal T-cell immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs have fine azurophilic granules, occur transiently after viral infection or splenectomy and are polyclonal, whereas T-LGL leukemia is persistent (>6 months) and clonal.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL cells look identical morphologically but lack surface CD3 and TCR and express CD16/CD56.
Congenital Chediak-Higashi syndrome shows giant granules in neutrophils, eosinophils and lymphocytes with albinism and immunodeficiency, not an isolated granular lymphocyte population.
A superimposed platelet shows a pale hyalomere with fine purple granules and lies in a different focal plane, rather than discrete dense red granules within the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia — lymphocyte with coarse pseudo-Chediak-Higashi-like azurophilic granules; needs clonal T-cell confirmation
pearls_zh: 考法：顆粒只有兩顆且集中一側，考官可能問「是否只是疊上去的血小板」——看顆粒是否位於胞質內、同一焦平面，且為分離的紅色緻密顆粒。
LGL 顆粒內含 perforin、granzyme B 等細胞毒殺蛋白；IHC 可表現 TIA-1、granzyme B，反映 cytotoxic T 細胞來源。
T-LGL 的血球減少中，中性球減少通常比貧血更突出，與 Fas/Fas ligand 等機轉相關；PRCA 為另一經典關聯。
WHO 5th 將 NK 細胞的對應疾病改稱 NK-large granular lymphocytic leukemia（取代 chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 顆粒易被誤認為疊在細胞上的血小板：血小板有淡色 hyalomere 與細顆粒、焦平面不同；LGL 顆粒則是胞質內分離的紅色緻密顆粒。

quiz.q: 此細胞胞質中的粗大紅色顆粒含有哪些細胞毒殺蛋白？
quiz.a: Perforin、granzyme B（TIA-1）

63196.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片滿是寬卵圓形紅血球，紅箭頭指 Y 形或 V 形口形，黑箭頭指兩道平行裂隙、中間夾著血紅素較飽滿的脊，呈雙口形或 knizocyte 樣；卵圓形加多重口形是東南亞卵圓形紅血球症（SAO）的線索。
features: Predominance of broad oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes) with good hemoglobinization
Y- or V-shaped stomas (red arrows)
Cells with two parallel slits separated by a hemoglobinized ridge, resembling double stomatocytes or knizocytes (black arrows)
Transverse, off-center and longitudinal single slits in other ovalocytes
No spherocytes or schistocytes; scattered platelets and an occasional larger rounder cell
63196.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominance of broad oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes), many with stomatocytic slits. Some stomas are Y- or V-shaped (red arrows), and others consist of two parallel slits separated by a well-hemoglobinized ridge, giving a double stomatocyte or knizocyte appearance (black arrows). Transverse, off-center and longitudinal single slits are also present. Spherocytes and schistocytes are not seen. Findings are consistent with Southeast Asian ovalocytosis.

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are elongated with parallel sides and lack slits or knizocyte-like ridges.
Round stomatocytes with a single slit, often with macrocytosis and hemolysis, rather than oval cells with multiple stomas.
Isolated pinched or ridged cells occur in spherocytosis or after splenectomy but are not set in a uniformly oval, stomatocytic population.

exam.answer_en: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis — macro-ovalocytes with Y/V-shaped stomas and double parallel slits (knizocyte-like) cells
pearls_zh: 考法：黑箭頭雙平行裂隙夾一條血紅素脊的細胞，考官會問是否屬於 SAO 的形態譜；答：是，多重 stoma 是 SAO 的特徵之一。
分子機轉：band 3 缺失 9 個胺基酸後失去陰離子交換功能並易聚集，膜蛋白側向移動受限，細胞變僵硬而形成卵圓形。
體染色體顯性：父母之一通常有相同抹片表現，家族篩檢用抹片初篩、SLC4A1 27-bp deletion PCR 確認。
滲透脆性試驗在 SAO 通常不增加（膜僵硬），可與 HS 的滲透脆性上升作對照。
exam.pitfall_zh: 雙裂隙細胞易被當成 HS 或脾切除後的 knizocyte；關鍵在背景是否為整片寬卵圓細胞且普遍帶 stoma，而非球形紅血球。

quiz.q: 黑箭頭所指、兩道平行裂隙中間夾血紅素脊的細胞稱為什麼？見於此片提示何診斷？
quiz.a: Double stomatocyte／knizocyte-like cell；Southeast Asian ovalocytosis

63132.recognize_zh: IgG4 染色中，大量深棕色陽性漿細胞群聚於含脂肪與纖維化的組織中；Rosai-Dorfman 病常見 IgG4+ 漿細胞增加，須搭配 S-100 陽性組織球與 emperipolesis 才能與 IgG4 相關疾病區分。
features: IHC for IgG4 on tissue, intermediate power
Numerous strongly positive plasma cells in clusters and cords
Positive cells concentrated in a cellular band; adjacent fibrous stroma sparsely involved
Large pale histiocytes and interspersed adipocytes are negative
Faint background stromal staining
63132.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for IgG4 highlights numerous positive plasma cells arranged in clusters and cords within a cellular infiltrate containing interspersed adipocytes, with fewer positive cells in the adjacent fibrous stroma. The large histiocytes are negative. Increased IgG4-positive plasma cells are a recognized finding in Rosai-Dorfman disease and require correlation with IgG stain, S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis, and clinical features to exclude IgG4-related disease.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and elevated IgG4/IgG ratio (>40%) but lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis; increased IgG4+ plasma cells can occur in RDD and should not be used alone.
MZL may show IgG4+ plasma cells but has monotypic light-chain expression and a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate.
Plasmacytoma shows sheets of monotypic plasma cells and does not have admixed S100+ histiocytes.

63004.recognize_zh: 組織切片中為成片、單一形態的漿細胞樣細胞，核偏心圓形、胞質中等量嗜伊紅至雙染性，被纖維血管間質分隔；免疫染色依序為膜狀陽性（如 CD138）、以及兩個胞質強陽性的染色（推測為免疫球蛋白重鏈/輕鏈），支持單株性漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma），此例為 IgA 型。
features: Diffuse sheets of monomorphic plasmacytoid cells separated by fibrovascular septa (A)
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; perinuclear hofs in some cells
Strong membranous staining of nearly all tumor cells in panel B (consistent with CD138)
Diffuse cytoplasmic staining of tumor cells in panels C and D (consistent with immunoglobulin heavy/light chain restriction; markers not labeled)
No admixed small lymphoid or germinal center component evident
63004.describe_en: Composite of a tissue biopsy. The H&E section shows diffuse sheets of monomorphic plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, separated by delicate fibrovascular septa (A). Immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous positivity in virtually all tumor cells (B, consistent with CD138) and diffuse cytoplasmic staining in panels C and D, which in context represent immunoglobulin heavy chain (IgA) and light chain restriction; the specific markers are not labeled in the figure. There is no significant background lymphoid or follicular component. Findings are consistent with a plasmacytoma of IgA type; exclusion of systemic plasma cell myeloma by marrow examination and imaging is required before classifying it as solitary.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with marked plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL contains a CD20+ monocytoid/small B-cell component and colonized follicles, whereas plasmacytoma is a pure CD20-negative, CD138+ plasma cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, very high Ki-67, starry-sky pattern and frequent EBER positivity, unlike mature-appearing plasma cells.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed with other inflammatory cells and are polytypic for kappa and lambda without heavy chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with extramedullary involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation requires bone marrow biopsy, skeletal imaging and assessment of CRAB/myeloma-defining events.

62940.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片上可見一條長而彎曲的線狀寄生蟲，蟲體內充滿一列列紫色核柱，一端延伸出淡粉紅色、不含核的鞘狀構造，大小遠超過周圍紅血球，符合微絲蟲（microfilaria）；結合臨床為班氏絲蟲（Wuchereria bancrofti）。
features: Elongated, curved worm-like organism many times the length of a red cell
Body filled with densely packed purple-staining nuclei arranged in a column
Pale pink sheath-like extension beyond the nuclear column at one end
Gentle curves with a coiled segment at one end
Adjacent smudged pink-purple cellular debris and pale red cell ghosts in the background
62940.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single elongated, gracefully curved microfilaria many times the length of a red cell, with a column of densely packed purple somatic nuclei. A pale pink, anucleate sheath-like extension projects beyond the nuclear column at one end, and adjacent smudged cellular debris is present. Species-level features such as the tail-tip nuclei are difficult to assess in this photograph. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with microfilaremia due to Wuchereria bancrofti.

ddx.vs: Brugia microfilariae are sheathed but have kinked curves, a sheath that stains pink with Giemsa, and two separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip.
Loa loa is sheathed with nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip and is found in daytime blood in Central/West Africa.
Mansonella microfilariae are small, unsheathed, and have nuclei extending to a blunt tail tip.
Fibers lack internal nuclei and a defined cephalic space and are refractile rather than stained.

exam.answer_en: Microfilaremia (Wuchereria bancrofti) — sheathed microfilaria with column of somatic nuclei on peripheral smear
pearls_zh: 考法：指長條蟲體問是什麼（microfilaria），再問種別辨識重點：有無鞘（sheath）與尾端核是否延伸到尾尖。
W. bancrofti：有鞘、優雅弧形、尾端無核；Brugia malayi：有鞘、扭曲、尾端有兩顆分開的核；Loa loa：核連續延伸到尾尖。
W. bancrofti 多為夜間週期性（nocturnal periodicity），應於夜間（約 22 時至 2 時）採血；可用厚血片或濃縮法。
臨床：淋巴管炎、象皮病、乳糜尿；嗜伊紅性球增多，tropical pulmonary eosinophilia。治療用 DEC（排除 onchocerciasis/Loa loa 高負荷）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為纖維、黴菌菌絲或塗抹細胞殘骸：微絲蟲有規則排列的一列細胞核與鞘；也需與 Brugia、Loa loa 依尾端核分布區分。

quiz.q: 此血片中的長條寄生蟲是什麼？班氏絲蟲應在什麼時段採血？
quiz.a: Microfilaria（Wuchereria bancrofti）；夜間（nocturnal periodicity）

62876.recognize_zh: 四格免疫染色：CD20 僅少數散在 B 細胞，CD3 與 CD2 在腺窩間固有層呈瀰漫陽性，而 CD5 大部分陰性（CD5 表現喪失），顯示異常 T 細胞表型；注意圖中標示為 CD5 而非標題的 CD8。
features: CD20: only rare scattered positive B cells in the lamina propria
CD3: diffuse positivity of the lamina propria infiltrate between crypts
CD2: strong diffuse membranous staining of the same infiltrate
CD5: largely negative in the infiltrate with only scattered positive cells (aberrant loss)
Crypts intact and negative for all markers
62876.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical panel of colonic mucosa shows that the lamina propria infiltrate is diffusely positive for CD3 and CD2, with only rare CD20-positive B cells. CD5 stains only scattered cells, indicating aberrant loss of CD5 in the neoplastic T-cell population. The crypts are preserved. Note that the four panels are labeled CD20, CD3, CD5 and CD2, whereas the title lists CD8 instead of CD5. The findings support an immunophenotypically aberrant T-cell infiltrate consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells retain pan-T-cell antigens including CD5 and are accompanied by more B cells and plasma cells.
MALT lymphoma would show sheets of CD20-positive cells rather than rare B cells in a CD3-positive infiltrate.
NK/T-cell lymphoma lacks surface CD3 and CD5, is CD56 and EBER positive, and shows angiocentric necrosis.

62748.recognize_zh: 抹片背景散布大量細菌（小型桿菌/球桿菌，部分成短鏈），但都在細胞外、未被中性球吞噬，中性球也沒有中毒性顆粒或空泡；流式 FS/SS 圖左下角另有低前向散射的小顆粒族群（紅箭頭），提示檢體被細菌污染而非真正菌血症。
features: Numerous small extracellular bacteria (coccobacilli/short rods, some in short chains) scattered across the background
Absence of intracellular (phagocytosed) organisms within neutrophils
Segmented neutrophils without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuolation
Occasional degenerating cells; red cells not conspicuous in this field
Flow cytometry FS/SS plot with a discrete population of very low forward/side scatter events near the origin (arrow), consistent with bacteria/debris
62748.describe_en: The smear shows many segmented neutrophils in a background of abundant small extracellular bacteria, including coccobacilli and short chains, without phagocytosed organisms, toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolation in the neutrophils. The accompanying flow cytometry forward/side scatter plot shows an abnormal cluster of very low-scatter events below the usual threshold (arrow), corresponding to particulate bacterial material. The absence of a host neutrophil response to the organisms suggests in vitro overgrowth. Findings are suggestive of specimen contamination (for example delayed processing or a contaminated tube) rather than true bacteremia; a repeat properly collected sample and blood culture correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Usually shows organisms engulfed within neutrophils or monocytes together with toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and vacuolization.
Precipitate is irregular in size and shape, refractile and lies on top of cells, whereas bacteria are uniform rods or cocci with consistent morphology.
Platelets are larger with granular centers and variable shape, and cryoglobulin forms amorphous pale blue deposits rather than uniform chained bacteria.

62684.recognize_zh: 高倍下以大型中心母細胞（泡狀染色質、近核膜的多個小核仁）為主，混有核有切痕的中心細胞，並有有絲分裂與凋亡小體；大細胞比例高，代表濾泡性淋巴瘤中的高級別區域。
features: Predominance of large centroblasts with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripheral nucleoli
Admixed smaller cleaved/angulated centrocytes
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Eosinophilic fibrillary stroma between cells; no starry-sky pattern
62684.describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a crowded population composed predominantly of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral small nucleoli, admixed with smaller cleaved centrocytes. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are present, but no starry-sky macrophage pattern is seen. The high proportion of centroblasts in this field would correspond to a high-grade area if present within neoplastic follicles. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with numerous centroblasts; exclusion of a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma component requires correlation with architecture and CD21.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without FDC meshworks, so architecture and CD21 staining rather than cytology separate it.
Grade 3B follicles contain solid sheets of centroblasts without centrocytes, whereas centrocytes are admixed here.
Reactive centers contain tingible body macrophages with polarization and are BCL2 negative.

62620.recognize_zh: H&E 低中倍（比例尺 200 µm）可見緻密膠原間質中有成群、成片的中大型非典型細胞浸潤，細胞質嗜雙染、核較大；此倍率細胞學細節有限，需配合 HHV8/LANA 染色確認為體腔外型 PEL。
features: Dermal/submucosal-type tissue with dense eosinophilic collagen (scale bar 200 µm)
Infiltrate of intermediate-to-large atypical cells in cords, nests and sheets dissecting collagen
Cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and enlarged hyperchromatic to vesicular nuclei
Scattered small lymphoid aggregate at left upper field
Cytologic detail (nucleoli, plasmablastic features) limited at this magnification
62620.describe_en: Section of tissue at low-to-intermediate power shows an infiltrate of intermediate-to-large atypical cells arranged in cords, nests and sheets that dissect a dense collagenous stroma, with a small lymphoid aggregate. The cells have moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and enlarged nuclei, but nucleolar and plasmablastic detail cannot be resolved at this magnification, and the nested pattern could mimic carcinoma or melanoma. Immunostains on this case show HHV8/LANA nuclear positivity with CD45 and MUM1 expression and lack of immunoglobulin light chains, supporting extracavitary (solid) primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma nests are cohesive and keratin-positive and CD45-negative, whereas PEL cells are CD45+, MUM1+ and HHV8/LANA+.
Kaposi sarcoma is composed of spindle cells lining slit-like vessels with extravasated RBCs, not round large lymphoid cells, though both are HHV8-positive.
ALCL can infiltrate in cohesive sheets and is CD30-positive but expresses T-cell antigens and is HHV8-negative.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has similar immunophenotype but is HHV8/LANA-negative.

62556.recognize_zh: 中倍下是一片中等大小、核圓、胞質少的單調腫瘤細胞，散布著空泡狀的吞噬碎屑巨噬細胞與凋亡小體、核分裂，呈星空樣；形態介於 Burkitt 與 DLBCL 之間，需 FISH 確認雙打擊。
features: Monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered tingible-body macrophages with clear halos (starry sky)
Frequent apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures
Thin fibrovascular strands and small vessels coursing through diffuse sheets
No follicles or nodular architecture
62556.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, traversed by thin fibrovascular strands. Numerous tingible-body macrophages with clear halos, apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures are present, producing a starry-sky pattern. No nodular or follicular architecture is seen. The features indicate a high-grade B-cell lymphoma; distinction from Burkitt lymphoma and DLBCL requires BCL2 and MYC immunostains and FISH for MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are more uniform with squared-off cytoplasmic borders, BCL2-negative and Ki67 near 100%, with MYC rearrangement only.
DLBCL cells are larger (at least twice a small lymphocyte) with more pleomorphism and lack double rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive and usually lacks a prominent starry sky.
Lymphoblasts have very fine chromatin and are TdT-positive with often weak or absent CD20.

62492.recognize_zh: 高度細胞化骨髓中巨核細胞大量增加，多數體積小、核低分葉，散在或成小群，背景為密集顆粒球系細胞並有出血，符合 CML 加速期的巨核細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly increased megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes predominantly small with hypolobated nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, singly and in small clusters
Background granulocytic proliferation at various stages of maturation
Areas of hemorrhage/extravasated red cells at right
No sheets of blasts seen
62492.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at medium power shows a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and a marked increase in megakaryocytes, which are predominantly small with hypolobated nuclei and occur singly and in small clusters. Focal hemorrhage is present. No sheets of blasts are identified. Findings are consistent with BCR::ABL1-positive CML with prominent megakaryocytic proliferation, compatible with accelerated phase when correlated with blast count, basophils, fibrosis and cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are large and bizarre with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei, and the neoplasm lacks BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity has large ET-like megakaryocytes with ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation, not small hypolobated forms.
Chronic phase also has small megakaryocytes, so phase depends on blast percentage, basophils, platelet count, additional cytogenetic abnormalities and TKI response.

62428.recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片形態相當一致的中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞邊界因收縮假影呈方形互相擠壓（squared-off），核染色質點狀、可見數個小核仁，細胞質少量；這種單形性中型細胞是伯奇氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）的線索，但仍需免疫染色與 MYC 檢測佐證。
features: Monomorphic population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells
Squared-off cell borders with retraction artifact giving a cohesive, molded appearance
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with stippled chromatin
Multiple small nucleoli in many nuclei
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Thin fibrovascular septa; tingible-body macrophages not prominent in this field
62428.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse proliferation of monomorphic, intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with stippled chromatin, multiple small nucleoli, and scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; retraction artifact produces squared-off cell borders. A well-developed starry-sky pattern is not appreciated in this high-power field. The findings are suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma, and confirmation with CD10, BCL6, BCL2, Ki-67 and MYC FISH is required.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows more pleomorphic, larger cells (nuclei exceeding histiocyte nuclei) with variable nucleoli, and typically a Ki-67 index below 90%.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology can be Burkitt-like, so distinction relies on BCL2 expression and FISH showing BCL2 rearrangement.
Lymphoblasts have finer, dust-like chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and are TdT-positive.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive and usually CD10-negative.

62364.recognize_zh: SOX11 核染色在增厚的外套層中呈強而瀰漫的棕色核陽性，中央的生發中心則為藍色陰性，形成「陽性環包圍陰性中心」的外套層型態，是外套細胞淋巴瘤的典型標記。
features: Strong diffuse nuclear SOX11 staining in expanded mantle zones
Germinal centers are SOX11-negative, creating a ring-like pattern around pale follicle centers
Monotonous small lymphoid cells in the positive zones
Interfollicular areas and perinodal fat largely negative
62364.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for SOX11 shows strong nuclear positivity in a monotonous population occupying markedly expanded mantle zones, while residual reactive germinal centers are negative. This ring-like distribution around preserved germinal centers represents the mantle zone growth pattern. Nuclear SOX11 expression is highly specific among small B-cell lymphomas and, with CD5 and cyclin D1 co-expression, is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, including cyclin D1-negative cases.

ddx.vs: Reactive mantle B cells are SOX11-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
In situ MCN shows cyclin D1+/SOX11 +/- cells restricted to the inner mantle of otherwise normal-sized mantles, not markedly expanded mantle zones.
Non-nodal MCL is typically SOX11-negative with IGHV mutation and presents in blood/spleen rather than nodal mantle expansion.
These can be SOX11+ but are CD10+ or TdT+ high-grade tumors with diffuse architecture.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern — SOX11 nuclear positivity in expanded mantle zones around negative germinal centers
pearls_zh: 考法：SOX11 陽性環繞陰性生發中心，問此型態與標記意義：mantle zone growth pattern 的 MCL；SOX11 為核染，在小 B 細胞淋巴瘤中對 MCL 高度特異。
SOX11 可幫助診斷 cyclin D1 陰性 MCL（常帶 CCND2 重排）；典型 MCL 為 t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH，CD5+、CD23−、CD200−。
SOX11 陰性的 leukemic non-nodal MCL 多為 IGHV mutated、表現周邊血與脾臟侵犯，病程較惰性。
預後不良因子：blastoid/pleomorphic 型、Ki-67 高、TP53 突變或缺失；需與 MIPI 一起評估治療強度。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 in situ mantle cell neoplasia 混淆：後者 cyclin D1+/SOX11+ 細胞僅侷限於正常寬度的內層 mantle zone；本圖 mantle zone 明顯擴大，屬 MCL mantle zone pattern。

quiz.q: 此 IHC 的陽性分布（陽性環包圍陰性中心）稱為什麼生長型態？SOX11 對 cyclin D1 陰性病例有何用途？
quiz.a: Mantle zone pattern；可協助診斷 cyclin D1-negative MCL

62300.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散在許多紅血球邊緣有一口被咬掉般的缺口（咬痕細胞，bite cells），並有少數小而深染、形狀不規則的紅血球，配合服用 dapsone 的病史，提示藥物引起的氧化性溶血。
features: Scattered bite cells (degmacytes) with peripheral semicircular defects
Occasional small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells
Otherwise largely normocytic red cells with preserved central pallor
Adequate platelets with a small platelet clump
Occasional white cell at the field edge; no agglutination or schistocyte predominance
62300.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominantly normocytic red cell population with scattered bite cells showing semicircular peripheral defects and occasional small, dense, irregularly contracted cells. There is no significant red cell agglutination, spherocytosis or schistocytosis in this field, and platelets appear adequate with a small clump. The magnification limits assessment for blister cells and Heinz bodies, for which a supravital stain would be helpful. In the setting of dapsone therapy, a negative DAT and normal G6PD activity, the findings are consistent with drug-induced oxidative hemolysis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical (bite and blister cells, Heinz bodies), so a G6PD enzyme assay performed away from the acute episode is needed to separate them.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce bite cells and Heinz bodies but are chronic and inherited, identified by isopropanol stability testing and hemoglobin analysis.
Warm AIHA produces spherocytes and polychromasia rather than bite cells and has a positive direct antiglobulin test.
MAHA shows helmet cells and fragmented schistocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than bite cells with adequate platelets.

exam.answer_en: Dapsone-induced oxidative hemolysis — scattered bite cells and small dense contracted red cells, DAT-negative
pearls_zh: 考法：用藥史加 bite cell，問溶血機轉：oxidative（Heinz body 形成），DAT 陰性，屬非免疫性溶血。
Dapsone 的溶血為劑量相關，G6PD 正常者也會發生，G6PD deficiency 者更嚴重；用藥前建議篩檢 G6PD。
Dapsone 同時造成 methemoglobinemia：pulse oximetry 約 85% 左右且給氧不改善，需 co-oximetry；治療用 methylene blue，但 G6PD deficiency 者禁用。
HLA-B*13:01 與 dapsone hypersensitivity syndrome 相關，在台灣等華人族群有篩檢意義。
exam.pitfall_zh: 小而緻密的紅血球易誤認為 spherocyte 而想到 autoimmune hemolytic anemia：此例 DAT 陰性且伴 bite cells，屬氧化性溶血；AIHA 則 DAT 陽性、以 spherocytes 為主。

quiz.q: 圖中邊緣有缺口的紅血球稱為什麼？dapsone 除溶血外還常引起哪一種需 co-oximetry 診斷的異常？
quiz.a: Bite cell（degmacyte）；methemoglobinemia
