62236.recognize_zh: 下半部多顆圓形核偏心、細胞質灰藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞聚集，部分核染色質較開放且可見核仁，漿細胞明顯增加，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous plasma cells with round eccentric nuclei and moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof visible in several cells
Some plasma cells show open chromatin with visible nucleoli (atypical/immature forms)
Admixed band neutrophils, myelocytes and small lymphocytes
Fat vacuoles and hemodilute background
62236.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells, forming a prominent population among the nucleated cells in this field. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei, moderately abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs, and several display less condensed chromatin with nucleoli. Residual granulocytic precursors and small lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, to be confirmed by plasma cell percentage and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and polytypic without nucleoli, whereas clonal kappa/lambda restriction and aberrant CD56/CD117 with loss of CD19/CD45 support myeloma.
MGUS has <10% clonal marrow plasma cells without CRAB/SLiM features, so the distinction relies on quantitation and clinical criteria rather than cytology.
LPL shows small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein rather than sheets of plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — clusters of increased plasma cells, some atypical with open chromatin and nucleoli, in the marrow aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：要求在混合骨髓細胞中找出漿細胞並估計是否增加；成群聚集與出現核仁的不成熟形態都支持腫瘤性。
CRAB：hypercalcemia、renal insufficiency、anemia、bone lesions；腎損傷最常見原因為 light chain cast nephropathy。
實驗室配套：SPEP + immunofixation、serum free light chain、24 小時尿蛋白電泳；beta2-microglobulin、albumin、LDH 與高風險細胞遺傳學用於 R-ISS/R2-ISS 分期。
漿細胞形態可見 Mott cell、Russell body、Dutcher body（核內包涵體）、flame cell，考試常要求辨認其名稱。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把成群的 myelocyte 或 osteoblast 誤認為漿細胞：osteoblast 核偏心但體積較大、hof 與核分離；myelocyte 細胞質有顆粒且無深藍嗜鹼性。

quiz.q: 下半部聚集、核偏心、有核旁淡染區的細胞是什麼？多發性骨髓瘤的 CRAB 指哪四項？
quiz.a: Plasma cells；hypercalcemia、renal insufficiency、anemia、bone lesions

62172.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片幾乎全是紅血球系前驅細胞：大型原紅血球母細胞（proerythroblast）細胞質深藍、核圓，並夾雜各階段較成熟的紅血球母細胞，部分核出現分葉、出芽或變形；紅系比例極高且具異型，但單一視野無法計算是否達純紅系白血病標準。
features: Marked predominance of erythroid precursors at different stages of maturation
Proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with round nuclei, granular chromatin and rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Dyserythropoietic nuclear changes: lobulated, budding, elongated and irregular nuclei
Relatively few granulocytic cells (occasional band/segmented neutrophils)
Background with red cells and fine granular debris
62172.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field dominated by erythroid precursors across a spectrum of maturation, from proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei to later erythroblasts with condensed chromatin. Many erythroid cells show nuclear irregularities, including lobulation, budding and elongated forms. Granulocytic elements are sparse. Although the erythroid proliferation is striking, a differential count is needed to document >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts; in that context, the findings would be consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: MDS may show erythroid hyperplasia with dysplasia but lacks the ≥30% proerythroblasts with >80% erythroid cells required for pure erythroid leukemia.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts have fine sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and resolve with B12/folate replacement.

ddx.dx: Erythroid regeneration after chemotherapy, hemolysis or parvovirus recovery
ddx.vs: Regenerating erythroid cells are synchronous and cytologically bland without TP53 abnormalities or complex karyotype, and clinical history explains the expansion.

62108.recognize_zh: 在偏光下，骨髓腔內密集的針狀、扇形排列結晶呈明亮的多彩雙折射（birefringent），與周圍紅染的骨小樑及纖維組織對比明顯，支持草酸鈣結晶沉積。
features: Examination under polarized light shows abundant brightly birefringent crystals
Needle- and plate-shaped crystals in sheaf-like/radiating clusters filling the marrow space
Multicolored (white, blue-green, yellow) birefringence from crystalline material
Intervening reddish fibrous stroma and adjacent bony trabecula at the edges
No residual hematopoietic tissue identifiable
62108.describe_en: Section of bone marrow biopsy stained with Congo red and examined under polarized light shows the intertrabecular space extensively replaced by numerous needle- and plate-shaped crystals in radiating clusters that display bright, multicolored birefringence. Reddish fibrous stroma is present between the crystal aggregates, and no normal hematopoietic tissue is seen. The crystal shape and strong birefringence are characteristic of calcium oxalate rather than amyloid, which would instead show apple-green birefringence of amorphous material. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is amorphous, Congo red-positive, and shows apple-green birefringence rather than discrete needle-shaped crystals with bright white/multicolored birefringence.
Urate crystals are strongly negatively birefringent needles usually lost in aqueous processing, whereas oxalate rosettes persist in routine fixed tissue.
Foreign material is typically intracellular in giant cells and plate-like/Maltese-cross or fibrillar, not diffuse radiating crystal sheaves.

62044.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色高倍下，背景小淋巴球大多陰性，而散在的數顆大型細胞呈強烈膜狀或細胞質陽性，核大淡染並有環狀膜染色，顯示大型 LP 細胞被標記、周圍為非該抗原表現的小淋巴球背景。
features: Scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic red staining, some showing a crisp complete membrane ring
Positive large cells have large pale vesicular nuclei, several times the size of background lymphocytes
Background small round lymphocytes are predominantly negative
Large positive cells are dispersed singly without confluent sheets in this field
Antibody identity not labeled; pattern fits a B-cell or LP-cell marker (e.g. CD20, OCT2 would be nuclear, EMA membranous)
62044.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at high power shows scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining and large vesicular nuclei, set in a background of predominantly negative small lymphocytes. The positive large cells are dispersed singly and do not form sheets in this field. If the marker is a B-cell antigen such as CD20, the negative small lymphocyte background indicates a T-cell-rich milieu, which in a known nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma raises concern for a T-cell-rich (diffuse) variant pattern or evolution toward T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma. Findings are consistent with highlighted LP cells; correlation with architecture and the full immunopanel (CD3, PD-1, CD21) is required.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL shows the same scattered CD20+ large cells in a T-cell-rich background but diffusely, without residual CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks or PD-1+ rosettes.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and usually negative or heterogeneous CD20, unlike uniform strong membranous staining of LP cells for B-cell markers.
EBV+ DLBCL can contain scattered large B cells in a reactive background but shows EBER positivity in the large cells, which is typically negative in NLPHL.

61916.recognize_zh: 高倍下腺體間充滿中型、核形不規則且略有摺痕的細胞，細胞質淡染至微嗜酸性，核染色質中等偏深、核仁不明顯；腺體完整、未見壞死或血管破壞，是NK細胞腸病的細胞學特徵，但須以免疫染色與EBER排除NK/T細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated to indented nuclei
Moderately dense chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to faintly eosinophilic cytoplasm (cytoplasmic granules not resolved on H&E)
Infiltrate fills the lamina propria between intact glands without evident gland destruction
No necrosis or angiodestruction; scattered small capillaries with red cells
61916.describe_en: High-power examination of gastrointestinal mucosa shows the lamina propria filled by medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei, moderately dense chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm. The infiltrate surrounds intact glands without significant epitheliotropism, necrosis or angiodestructive features. Mitotic activity is not prominent in this field. The cytologic atypia raises concern for NK/T-cell lymphoma, but in the context of an NK-cell phenotype (CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+, CD5-), EBER negativity and a superficial non-destructive pattern, the findings are compatible with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is EBER-positive with angiocentric destruction and coagulative necrosis, whereas NK-cell enteropathy is EBER-negative and non-destructive.
MEITL cells invade crypt epithelium extensively and show clonal TCR rearrangement with surface CD3/CD8 expression.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than NK-cell markers.

61852.recognize_zh: Langerin（CD207）染色下，成片的卵圓形腫瘤細胞完全呈陰性，只有極少數零星棕色點；在 CD1a 與 S100 陽性的前提下，Langerin 陰性正是區分不定型樹突細胞腫瘤與蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症的關鍵。
features: Diffuse sheets of ovoid tumor cells with hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei only
No membranous or cytoplasmic Langerin (CD207) staining in the tumor cells
Rare scattered brown granules, likely pigment or nonspecific background
Oval to grooved nuclei with moderate pale cytoplasm visible on counterstain
Pertinent negative stain in a CD1a-positive dendritic cell proliferation
61852.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Langerin (CD207) shows a diffuse sheet of ovoid tumor cells with grooved nuclei that are entirely negative, with only rare scattered brown granules that do not localize to tumor cell membranes or cytoplasm. An adequate internal or external positive control should be confirmed before interpretation. Langerin negativity in a CD1a-positive, S100-positive dendritic cell proliferation excludes Langerhans cell histiocytosis and is consistent with indeterminate dendritic cell tumor.

ddx.vs: LCH cells show diffuse granular cytoplasmic Langerin positivity corresponding to Birbeck granules, which is absent here.
Absent staining in a Langerhans-type proliferation must be validated by a positive control (e.g. epidermal Langerhans cells) before calling indeterminate cell tumor.
IDCS is also Langerin negative but is CD1a negative, whereas indeterminate cell tumor is CD1a positive.

61788.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中中型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少量藍色且無顆粒，許多核的一側有一塊淡染的凹陷區（箭頭），呈杯口狀核（cup-like nuclei）；雖常見於 NPM1 突變 AML，此例在 B-ALL 中出現。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly coarse chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Prominent pale nuclear invagination/pocket occupying part of the nucleus, giving a cup-like (fish-mouth) appearance (arrows in A-C)
Blasts appear singly and in small aggregates (B, C), without Auer rods or granules
Background red cells largely unremarkable; platelets scant
61788.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A subset of blasts shows a distinct pale nuclear invagination spanning a portion of the nucleus, producing cup-like nuclear morphology. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or maturing myeloid forms are seen in these fields. In the setting of a B-lineage immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with cup-like nuclei; because this morphology is classically associated with NPM1/FLT3-ITD-mutated AML, lineage must be established by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Blasts are typically larger with more cytoplasm, may show granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive, CD34/HLA-DR often negative, rather than CD19/CD10 positive.
Shows bilobed or folded 'butterfly' nuclei with fine granules, strong MPO, and CD34/HLA-DR negativity with PML::RARA.
Can show convoluted nuclei but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7 rather than B-lineage markers.
Promonocytes have folded delicate nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity.

61724.recognize_zh: 這是 live gate 的 HLA-DR 對 CD123 流式圖：綠色異常群 CD123 陽性且 HLA-DR 陽性，形成一大團；左上框內的嗜鹼性球（0.43%）是 CD123 陽性但 HLA-DR 陰性，可作為內部對照，突顯腫瘤群 CD123+/HLA-DR+ 的漿細胞樣樹突細胞表現型。
features: Dot plot: HLADR-PB (x-axis) versus CD123-APC (y-axis), gated on live events
Large abnormal population (green) co-expressing CD123 and HLA-DR at moderate intensity
Basophil gate (CD123+/HLA-DR-) at 0.43% serving as internal positive control for CD123
Major purple population (granulocytes) negative for both markers
Scattered gray HLA-DR-bright/CD123-dim events consistent with B cells or monocytes
61724.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of HLA-DR versus CD123 on live events shows a large abnormal population (green) that co-expresses CD123 and HLA-DR. Basophils (0.43%) are identified as CD123-positive/HLA-DR-negative and provide an internal reference, while the granulocytes are negative for both markers. The abnormal population has an HLA-DR+/CD123+ phenotype typical of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, and in the setting of an expanded CD4+/CD56+ blast population lacking lineage markers this supports blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. Note that the CD123 intensity here is moderate relative to the scale, and CD123 is also expressed on some AML blasts, so the full panel must be integrated.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD123 expression
ddx.vs: Many AMLs are CD123-positive but also express CD34/CD117 and CD13/CD33 and lack coordinated CD4/CD56 with TCF4/TCL1.

ddx.dx: Reactive or MN-associated mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell expansion
ddx.vs: Mature pDC expansions are CD123-bright/HLA-DR+ but CD56-negative, small in number, and accompany an underlying myeloid neoplasm.
Basophils are CD123+ but HLA-DR-negative, as shown by the gated population here.

61660.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間的造血組織明顯增生、脂肪空泡減少，並散布許多即使在低倍下也看得到的大型巨核細胞，呈現 PV 的全髓增生（panmyelosis）型態。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with markedly reduced fat
Panmyelosis with sheets of erythroid and granulocytic elements between trabeculae
Increased, conspicuous large megakaryocytes scattered and focally loosely clustered
Bony trabeculae of normal thickness without osteosclerosis
No obvious fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates at this magnification
61660.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with reduced adipose tissue between intact bony trabeculae. There is trilineage hyperplasia with increased, readily identified large megakaryocytes that are scattered and loosely clustered. No osteosclerosis or overt fibrosis is appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm, compatible with polycythemia vera in the proliferative phase.

ddx.vs: ET marrow is usually normocellular with megakaryocytic proliferation only, lacking the diffuse panmyelotic hypercellularity seen here.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic predominance with reduced erythropoiesis and dense clusters of bizarre hypolobated megakaryocytes, often with paratrabecular/endosteal clustering.
Secondary erythrocytosis may show mild erythroid hyperplasia but not megakaryocytic proliferation with clustering or panmyelosis.

exam.answer_en: Polycythemia vera, proliferative phase (low power) — markedly hypercellular marrow between trabeculae with panmyelosis and conspicuous large megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍先評估細胞量（依年齡校正，脂肪明顯減少即 hypercellular），再看低倍下即清楚可見的大型巨核細胞，答 panmyelosis → PV。
低倍同時觀察骨小樑有無增厚（osteosclerosis）與巨核細胞是否緊密成團，這些是 PMF/post-PV MF 的線索；本圖骨小樑正常。
必做 reticulin（與 trichrome）染色分級纖維化；診斷時已有輕度 reticulin 增加的 PV 較易進展為 post-PV myelofibrosis。
繼發性紅血球增多症骨髓通常只有紅系增生、無巨核細胞異常群聚，且 EPO 正常或升高，可與 PV 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把高細胞量誤判為 CML：CML 以顆粒球系極度增生、巨核細胞小而低分葉（dwarf megakaryocytes）為主，並有 BCR::ABL1；PV 巨核細胞大且多形，三系增生。

quiz.q: 低倍骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加、三系皆增生且巨核細胞醒目，稱為什麼型態？判讀此切片時必須另加哪個特殊染色？
quiz.a: Panmyelosis（polycythemia vera）；reticulin 染色評估纖維化。

61596.recognize_zh: 三格組合圖：A 為富細胞骨髓，巨核細胞明顯增加並聚集，其中不少是小型、單葉或低分葉核；B 為巨核細胞標記 IHC 顯示大量大小不一的陽性巨核細胞；C 為網狀纖維染色顯示纖維增加。小型單葉巨核細胞加上纖維化，呼應 del(5q) 與 JAK2 同時存在的特徵。
features: Hypercellular bone marrow with marked megakaryocytic hyperplasia and loose clustering (panel A)
Megakaryocytes of variable size, including many small forms with hypolobated or monolobated nuclei (panel A)
Megakaryocyte immunostain highlighting numerous positive megakaryocytes of variable size (panel B)
Reticulin stain showing increased reticulin fiber network (panel C)
Limited resolution precludes precise grading of fibrosis and detailed megakaryocyte nuclear morphology
61596.describe_en: This composite shows a bone marrow core biopsy. The H&E section (A) is hypercellular with marked megakaryocytic hyperplasia; megakaryocytes vary in size and include many small forms with hypolobated to monolobated nuclei, some in loose clusters. A megakaryocyte-lineage immunostain (B) highlights the increased megakaryocytes, and a reticulin stain (C) shows increased reticulin fibrosis. Image resolution limits formal fibrosis grading. Given the concurrent JAK2 mutation and isolated del(5q), the combination of small hypolobated megakaryocytes and marrow fibrosis reflects overlapping features of MDS with isolated del(5q) and a JAK2-driven myeloproliferative process.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are large, pleomorphic, with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei in dense clusters, rather than predominantly small monolobated forms.

ddx.dx: MDS with isolated del(5q) without JAK2 mutation
ddx.vs: Classic del(5q) MDS shows small monolobated megakaryocytes but usually no significant fibrosis and no JAK2-driven thrombocytosis/myeloproliferation.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T shows ring sideroblasts and large MPN-like megakaryocytes with SF3B1 mutation rather than isolated del(5q).
CML contains small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes and fibrosis but is defined by BCR::ABL1 with granulocytic hyperplasia and basophilia.

61532.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜切片 CD20 低倍影像中，黏膜內有一個大而清楚的圓形結節被 CD20 陽性 B 細胞整片填滿，並延伸入鄰近絨毛的固有層；上皮為陰性。形狀像擴大的濾泡，需再配合 CD10/BCL2 判定十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Low-power duodenal mucosal biopsy with a large, well-circumscribed nodular lymphoid aggregate
Diffuse strong membranous CD20 staining filling the nodule
CD20-positive B cells extending into the lamina propria of adjacent villi
Overlying villous epithelium CD20-negative; nodule expands the mucosa beneath the epithelium
Magnification too low to evaluate cytology or follicular/interfollicular zones
61532.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on a duodenal mucosal biopsy shows a large, well-circumscribed nodular lymphoid aggregate expanding the mucosa, uniformly filled by CD20-positive B cells, with additional B cells infiltrating the lamina propria of adjacent villi. The surface and crypt epithelium are negative. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In conjunction with CD10 and BCL2 co-expression in the follicle, findings are consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have a CD20+ germinal center with a mantle zone, are BCL2-negative in the germinal center and show polarization with tingible-body macrophages.
MALT lymphoma forms CD10-negative, BCL6-negative marginal zone infiltrates with lymphoepithelial lesions and follicular colonization, rather than CD10+/BCL2+ neoplastic follicles.
MCL nodules are CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD10-negative.

ddx.dx: Systemic follicular lymphoma secondarily involving the duodenum
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; staging showing nodal or marrow disease is required, as duodenal-type FL is typically localized to the small bowel.

61468.recognize_zh: 血片中央有一個新月形（香蕉形）配子體，周圍大量正常大小紅血球含細小環狀體與多重感染，並可見含褐色瘧色素的帶狀核中性球，以及小淋巴球／有核紅血球與較大的反應性單核細胞，綜合符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Crescent (banana-shaped) gametocyte in the center of the field
Numerous small delicate ring forms in normal-sized red cells, some cells with multiple rings or appliqué forms
Band and segmented neutrophils, two containing brown hemozoin pigment granules (left shift)
Large mononuclear cell with folded nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm (monocyte or reactive lymphocyte) and a small dark round cell (small lymphocyte vs nucleated red cell)
Smudged/disrupted cell at the upper right; platelets sparse
61468.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows heavy parasitemia with numerous small, delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes, including multiply infected cells and appliqué forms, and a single crescent-shaped gametocyte in the center of the field. Band and segmented neutrophils are present, two of which contain brown hemozoin pigment granules, indicating a left shift with pigment-laden neutrophils. A large mononuclear cell with a folded nucleus (monocyte versus reactive lymphocyte) and a small dark round cell (small lymphocyte versus nucleated red cell) are also seen, and a disrupted cell lies at the upper right. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria.

ddx.vs: Vivax shows enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, ameboid trophozoites and round gametocytes, not crescent gametocytes in normal-sized cells.
Malariae has band-form trophozoites, rosette schizonts and round gametocytes with low parasitemia, unlike this heavy multiply infected picture.
Babesia lacks pigment and gametocytes and may show tetrads and extracellular forms.
Sickle cells are entire red cells with pointed ends and no chromatin dots or internal pigment, unlike a crescent gametocyte with nuclear chromatin and pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — heavy ring-form parasitemia, a crescent gametocyte and hemozoin-laden neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：一張圖考三個點：多重感染的纖細 ring、中央的 crescent gametocyte、含棕黑色 hemozoin 的 neutrophil；三者合起來指向 P. falciparum。
Hemozoin（malarial pigment）是寄生蟲分解血紅素的產物；循環白血球內出現色素與較重病情及較高 parasite burden 相關。
重症判讀要點：parasitemia >10%、周邊出現 schizonts、腦病、嚴重貧血、低血糖、酸中毒、腎衰竭；重症治療首選 IV artesunate。
瘧疾診斷標準流程：thick film 找蟲（敏感度高）、thin film 分種與算 parasitemia；可輔以 rapid antigen test（HRP2）。
血小板低下在瘧疾非常常見，旅遊史＋發燒＋血小板低應主動看血片。
exam.pitfall_zh: Neutrophil 內的 hemozoin 易誤認為 toxic granulation；hemozoin 為棕黑色、折光的不規則顆粒，toxic granules 則為細小深紫藍色均勻顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中 neutrophil 胞質內的棕黑色顆粒是什麼？其存在有何臨床意義？
quiz.a: Hemozoin（malarial pigment）；與較重病情/較高寄生蟲負荷相關

61404.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD4（y 軸）對 CD8（x 軸）點圖，已圈選 CD3+ T 細胞：CD8+ 75.24%、CD4+ 17.00%，CD4/CD8 比例倒置約 1:4.4，另有 7.46% CD4-/CD8- 雙陰性 T 細胞，後者多為 γδ T 細胞。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on CD3+ events: CD4-APC750 versus CD8-ECD
CD4+CD8- T cells (red, upper left) 17.00%
CD4-CD8+ T cells (green, lower right) 75.24%, giving an inverted CD4:CD8 ratio of about 0.23
CD4-CD8- double-negative T cells (light blue, lower left) 7.46%, mildly increased
CD4+CD8+ double-positive events (dark blue, upper right) negligible at 0.31%
61404.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on CD3-positive T cells displays CD4 versus CD8 expression. CD8-positive T cells predominate (75.24%) over CD4-positive T cells (17.00%), yielding a markedly inverted CD4:CD8 ratio of approximately 1:4.4. A distinct CD4/CD8 double-negative T-cell population comprises 7.46% of T cells, and double-positive T cells are negligible (0.31%). The double-negative population is most often TCR gamma/delta T cells, which typically express brighter CD3 and dimmer CD5; confirmation requires TCR gamma/delta staining, and clonality cannot be determined from this plot alone.

ddx.dx: Reactive CD8 T-cell expansion (e.g. viral infection, HIV)
ddx.vs: Shows an inverted ratio with CD8 T cells of normal antigen intensity and preserved CD5/CD7, without a discrete aberrant population.
CD8+ T cells are clonal, often CD57+ with dim or lost CD5/CD7, requiring TRBC1 or TCR gene rearrangement studies to confirm.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma / gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Double-negative TCR gamma/delta+ cells are clonal and phenotypically aberrant (e.g. CD5 loss, CD56+), with clinical hepatosplenomegaly, rather than a small polyclonal population.

61340.recognize_zh: 三顆芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，下方芽細胞的細胞質中可見一條細長粉紅色的棒狀包涵體（Auer rod），直接指向骨髓性（myeloid）來源。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly indented nuclei
Finely granular, open chromatin with faint nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm; a slender pink-red Auer rod in the cytoplasm of the lower blast
Adjacent cell with dense purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus, most consistent with a basophil
Background erythrocytes with mild poikilocytosis and occasional crenated cells
61340.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. One blast contains a single slender Auer rod. A basophil is also present, and red cells show mild poikilocytosis. The presence of an Auer rod establishes myeloid lineage; findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, with subclassification (e.g., AML with maturation) requiring marrow evaluation, flow cytometry and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative, TdT and B- or T-lineage marker positive.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei with heavy granulation or multiple bundled Auer rods (faggot cells) rather than a single rod in an agranular blast.
Auer rods can occur in MDS, so blast percentage below 20% in blood and marrow and dysplasia define MDS rather than AML.
Döhle bodies are pale blue irregular cytoplasmic patches in maturing neutrophils, not needle-shaped pink rods in blasts.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia — circulating blasts, one containing a single slender Auer rod establishing myeloid lineage
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指母細胞細胞質中的粉紅細棒，問「這是什麼？代表什麼譜系？」答：Auer rod，由異常融合的嗜天青（primary）顆粒組成，確立 myeloid lineage。
Auer rod 為 MPO 陽性、Sudan black B 陽性；可藉 MPO 染色讓細小 Auer rod 更明顯。
單一細長 Auer rod 常見於 AML with maturation，t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1 典型為一條長而細、兩端尖的 Auer rod；多條成束則為 APL 的 faggot cell。
Auer rod 也可見於 MDS 與 CMML；在 MDS 中出現 Auer rod 會影響分類（WHO 2016 列為 MDS-EB2），因此發現時必須仔細計數原始細胞比例。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Auer rod 與 Döhle body 或重疊的血小板碎片混淆；Auer rod 為母細胞內細長針狀、粉紅至紫紅、MPO 陽性，Döhle body 為成熟嗜中性球中淡藍不規則斑塊。

quiz.q: 圖中下方母細胞內的細長粉紅棒狀物是什麼？它由何種顆粒構成？
quiz.a: Auer rod；融合的 primary（azurophilic）顆粒，MPO 陽性

61212.recognize_zh: 九宮格中的淋巴球為小至中型、核圓略有凹陷、染色質致密，細胞質淡藍且中等量，部分細胞一側有短絨毛狀突起（polar villi），但未見嗜天青顆粒，屬於邊緣區型淋巴球而非大顆粒淋巴球。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly indented or angulated nuclei and condensed chromatin
Moderate amounts of pale blue-grey cytoplasm, more abundant than in normal small lymphocytes
Several cells show short, often polar cytoplasmic projections (villous lymphocytes)
No visible azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Occasional nucleoli are not prominent; a normal segmented neutrophil is present for comparison
Normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
61212.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei, condensed chromatin and moderate amounts of pale blue-grey cytoplasm. Several cells display short, predominantly polar cytoplasmic villous projections, and cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not seen. Red cells are unremarkable. The findings represent a marginal zone-type lymphocytosis that can be mistaken for large granular lymphocytes at a glance; flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal B-cell population is required, and findings in the appropriate context are suggestive of circulating marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: LGLs have abundant clear cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and a CD3+CD8+CD57+ phenotype, whereas these cells lack granules and are B cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei with looser chromatin, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 positive with BRAF V600E.
CLL cells have scant cytoplasm, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, with CD5+CD23+ phenotype.
MCL cells often have irregular nuclei without villi, are CD5 positive and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

61148.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈高度細胞化，骨小樑旁的正常造血被一大片中型、卵圓核、淡灰藍色豐富胞質、細胞界限清楚的單一形態細胞取代，間雜嗜酸性顆粒的嗜酸球系細胞與散在巨核細胞，符合肥大細胞瀰漫浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Cells have round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei and moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Numerous interspersed eosinophils/eosinophilic precursors with bright red granules
Scattered megakaryocytes, some small or hypolobated
Bony trabecula at left; no fibrosis or granulomas evident at this magnification
61148.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular. Adjacent to a bony trabecula, normal hematopoietic elements are extensively replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm with distinct borders, imparting a fried-egg appearance. Numerous eosinophils and scattered, partly small megakaryocytes are admixed. The morphology is consistent with diffuse marrow infiltration by mast cells, as seen in mast cell leukemia; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells also show fried-egg spacing but are small B cells (CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive) without associated eosinophilia or tryptase positivity.
Blasts have finer chromatin with nucleoli and higher N:C ratio and are CD34/MPO or monocytic marker-positive and tryptase-negative.
Mast cells in PDGFRA neoplasms are usually loosely scattered or spindled rather than dense sheets and the lesion is defined by FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with desmoplasia and is keratin-positive and CD117/tryptase-negative.

61020.recognize_zh: 右上方大紅血球內有單一、圓形、深紫色、邊界清楚的小體（Howell-Jolly 小體）；中央的大紅血球內則是數個更小、不規則的藍色顆粒（Pappenheimer 小體），可在同一視野比較兩者差異，背景有明顯大小不一與變形紅血球。
features: Single round, dense, dark purple inclusion near the edge of a macrocytic red cell (upper right) = Howell-Jolly body
Central macrocyte with a few small, irregular basophilic granules = Pappenheimer bodies
Marked anisopoikilocytosis: macrocytes, microcytes, teardrop cell, ovalocytes, irregular/crenated cells and a target-like cell
Variably sized platelets scattered in the background
No leukocytes in the field
61020.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macrocytes, microcytes, a teardrop cell, ovalocytes, target-like and irregularly contoured red cells. A macrocyte at the upper right contains a single round, dense, dark purple Howell-Jolly body, and the large red cell in the center contains several small irregular basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. Platelets are present. The combination of Howell-Jolly and Pappenheimer bodies suggests hyposplenism or asplenia, possibly with an underlying dyserythropoietic or sideroblastic process; a Prussian blue stain can confirm the iron content of the Pappenheimer bodies.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are smaller, multiple, irregular and Prussian blue-positive, whereas the Howell-Jolly body is single, round, larger and Feulgen (DNA)-positive.
A platelet on top of a red cell has granular texture with a pale blue periphery rather than a homogeneous dense round inclusion.
A ring has a blue cytoplasmic loop attached to the chromatin dot, not a solitary solid dot.
Precipitate is refractile, lies in a different focal plane and is also found between cells.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly body — single round dense purple nuclear remnant in a red cell (with Pappenheimer bodies nearby), indicating hyposplenism
pearls_zh: 考法：本圖同一視野同時有 HJ body（右上，單一正圓）與 Pappenheimer bodies（中央，多顆細小），考官常要你指出兩者並說明成分差異：DNA vs 鐵。
HJ body 是紅血球脫核後殘留的 DNA 片段，Feulgen 陽性、Prussian blue 陰性；正常由脾臟清除，大量出現代表 asplenia 或 functional hyposplenism。
功能性脾低下常見原因：sickle cell disease（autosplenectomy）、celiac disease、脾臟放射治療或梗塞；另外 megaloblastic anemia 也可見 HJ body。
臨床連結：脾臟功能低下者對莢膜菌（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae type b、N. meningitidis）感染風險高，需完成疫苗接種並衛教發燒時及早就醫。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把覆蓋在紅血球上的血小板誤認為 HJ body：血小板呈顆粒狀、周邊淡藍、與紅血球不在同一焦平面；HJ body 則均質、緻密、邊界清楚且位於紅血球內。

quiz.q: 圖中右上方紅血球內單一圓形深紫色小體是什麼？它大量出現最常提示哪種狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body（DNA 殘體）；脾切除或功能性脾低下（hyposplenism）

60956.recognize_zh: 中型淋巴球具有豐富淡藍色細胞質，細胞核明顯分成兩葉（bilobed/binucleated lymphocyte），染色質成熟、無明顯核仁；在女性持續淋巴球增多的背景下，應聯想到持續性多株 B 細胞淋巴球增多症（PPBL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a deeply cleft, bilobed (binucleate-appearing) nucleus
Mature, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant, pale basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular border
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable; no smudge cells or blasts in this field
60956.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus composed of two closely apposed lobes, mature chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a generous rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. A normal segmented neutrophil and unremarkable red cells and platelets are present in the field. Binucleated lymphocytes of this type, in a patient with stable polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis and polyclonal IgM elevation, are suggestive of persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis; confirmation requires flow cytometry showing polyclonal (kappa and lambda) B cells.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+ with light-chain restriction rather than polyclonal.
Villous lymphocytes show polar cytoplasmic projections, not bilobed nuclei, and are monotypic by flow cytometry.
Flower cells have multilobated, hyperchromatic nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD4+ T cells, whereas PPBL cells are polyclonal B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are large with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and are transient, whereas PPBL shows persistent binucleated B cells with raised polyclonal IgM.

exam.answer_en: Persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis — binucleated/bilobed lymphocyte with mature chromatin and pale cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆雙葉核淋巴球問名稱並要你聯想疾病 → binucleated lymphocyte，典型出現在 PPBL；若只見少數，形態本身不具特異性。
典型病人：年輕至中年、吸菸女性，持續輕中度淋巴球增多，合併多株 IgM 上升；與 HLA-DR7 相關。
確診：flow 顯示多株性 B 細胞（kappa 與 lambda 皆表現），常為 CD27+ memory B 細胞；細胞遺傳學可見 i(3q) 或 +3q，並常有多個 IGH::BCL2 融合。
臨床多呈良性穩定病程，建議戒菸並定期追蹤血球；少數病例日後發生淋巴瘤，故需長期觀察。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 CLL 或 splenic marginal zone lymphoma：CLL 細胞小、核圓、CD5+/CD23+ 且輕鏈單株；SMZL 有絨毛狀突起與單株輕鏈；PPBL 為多株性並有特徵性雙核淋巴球。

quiz.q: 吸菸女性持續淋巴球增多，血片見圖中雙葉核淋巴球，最可能的診斷為何？flow cytometry 的關鍵發現是什麼？
quiz.a: Persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis（PPBL）；B 細胞為多株性（kappa 與 lambda 皆有）

60892.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞明顯增生，許多晚期正染性紅母細胞（orthochromatic normoblast）成對出現、看似雙核，配合終生貧血病史，提示 CDA type II（HEMPAS）。
features: Cellular aspirate with erythroid hyperplasia dominated by late (orthochromatic) normoblasts with small dense round nuclei
Numerous erythroid precursors with two closely apposed, equal-sized nuclei (binucleate forms)
Maturing granulocytic elements (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) present without obvious excess blasts
Scattered polychromatophilic and basophilic normoblasts with deep blue cytoplasm
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
60892.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia composed predominantly of late normoblasts. Many erythroid precursors are binucleate, with two similarly sized, round, condensed nuclei within a single cell. Granulocytic maturation is present and there is no increase in blasts in this field. Findings, in the context of lifelong anemia, are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS).

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges and spongy heterochromatin on EM, whereas CDA II features mostly late binucleate/multinucleate normoblasts.
CDA III contains giant multinucleate erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei rather than predominantly binucleate normal-sized late normoblasts.

MDS occurs in older adults with acquired cytopenias and multilineage dysplasia or ring sideroblasts/cytogenetic abnormalities, while CDA II is congenital with SEC23B mutation and hypoglycosylated band 3 on SDS-PAGE.
Hemolytic anemias show erythroid hyperplasia but binucleate precursors are rare and reticulocytosis is appropriate rather than inappropriately low.

exam.answer_en: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS) — marked erythroid hyperplasia with numerous binucleate late normoblasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩個等大圓核並列的正染性紅母細胞，問「這是什麼現象？哪種先天性貧血？」→ 晚期紅母細胞雙核，CDA type II。
HEMPAS = hereditary erythroblastic multinuclearity with positive acidified serum test：Ham test 陽性但 sucrose lysis test 陰性，可與 PNH 區分。
遺傳與確認：SEC23B 突變（體染色體隱性）；SDS-PAGE 見 band 3 hypoglycosylation；電顯有 peripheral double membrane。
臨床：網狀紅血球數相對貧血程度偏低、間接膽紅素升高、脾腫大、膽結石，常合併鐵過載，即使未輸血也要追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為遺傳性球形紅血球症等溶血性貧血：同樣有紅系增生、黃疸與脾腫大，但溶血性貧血網狀紅血球適當升高且雙核紅母細胞罕見；CDA II 有大量雙核晚期紅母細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中雙核晚期紅母細胞的疾病，Ham test 與 sucrose lysis test 結果分別為何？
quiz.a: Ham（acidified serum）test 陽性、sucrose lysis test 陰性（CDA II / HEMPAS）

60828.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在大型泡沫狀巨噬細胞（胞質充滿細小透明空泡），C 圖另有胞質呈藍色顆粒狀的海藍色組織球（sea-blue histiocyte）；D 圖胸部 X 光顯示網狀間質浸潤（箭頭），組合起來符合 Niemann-Pick B 型。
features: Large foamy macrophages with abundant cytoplasm filled with fine, uniform clear vacuoles (panels A-B)
Small round to irregular nuclei, sometimes eccentric, in the storage cells
Histiocytes with bluish, finely granular cytoplasm resembling sea-blue histiocytes (panel C)
Background of normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors without increased plasma cells
Chest radiograph (panel D) showing bilateral reticular interstitial markings, arrow at right lower zone
60828.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show normal trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered large storage histiocytes. These cells have abundant cytoplasm filled with small uniform clear vacuoles producing a foamy appearance, with small eccentric nuclei; other histiocytes contain bluish granular cytoplasm consistent with sea-blue histiocytes. No increase in atypical plasma cells is evident. The accompanying chest radiograph shows bilateral reticular interstitial infiltrates. Findings are consistent with a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease type B (acid sphingomyelinase deficiency), to be confirmed by enzyme assay and SMPD1 genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles and show low glucocerebrosidase activity.
NPC foam cells are morphologically similar but acid sphingomyelinase activity is normal, with NPC1/NPC2 mutations and neurologic disease.

ddx.dx: Secondary pseudo-storage histiocytes (e.g., myeloma, CML, ITP)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher or sea-blue histiocytes arise from high cell turnover and occur alongside the underlying neoplasm, such as clonal plasma cells in myeloma.

captions: A: marrow aspirate with foamy storage macrophages
B: foamy histiocytes with finely vacuolated cytoplasm
C: sea-blue-type histiocytes with blue granular cytoplasm
D: chest radiograph with reticular interstitial infiltrates (arrow)

60764.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有大量中至大型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質中度濃縮，可見單一清楚的中央核仁，細胞質中等量、淡藍色，這種「有核仁的中大型淋巴球」為主體是 B 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（B-PLL）的樣貌。
features: Numerous medium-to-large lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Round to oval, occasionally irregular or angulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single distinct central nucleolus visible in several cells
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles and small blebs
Relatively uniform population without small mature CLL-type lymphocytes or smudge cells in this field
60764.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct central nucleolus in many cells. The cells have a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, occasionally with fine vacuoles or small blebs. Small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a prolymphocytic proliferation of B-cell type (B-prolymphocytic leukemia), provided the B-cell phenotype is confirmed and mantle cell lymphoma is excluded by cyclin D1/t(11;14) testing.

ddx.dx: Leukemic blastoid or pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Can look identical, so cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression and CCND1 rearrangement must be excluded before diagnosing B-PLL.
Prolymphocytes make up fewer than 55% of lymphoid cells, set in a background of small CLL lymphocytes with smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.
Cells are smaller with cytoplasmic blebs and prominent nucleoli but express T-cell markers and TCL1 with inv(14)/t(14;14).

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: Cells show more abundant cytoplasm with villous projections and are CD11c/CD103 positive.

exam.answer_en: B-prolymphocytic leukemia (PB) — monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells with a single prominent central nucleolus; mantle cell lymphoma must be excluded
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指「中大型、單一明顯中央核仁、染色質中度濃縮」的細胞問這是什麼；關鍵是答出 prolymphocyte，並立刻提到必須排除 leukemic MCL（cyclin D1/SOX11、t(11;14)）。
傳統定義：周邊血 prolymphocytes >55% 的淋巴細胞；臨床典型為高齡、白血球極高、明顯脾腫大而淋巴結腫大不明顯。
分類變動：WHO 5th 已取消 B-PLL 這個獨立診斷，病例改歸入 MCL、CLL 進展（prolymphocytic progression）或 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli；ICC 2022 則仍保留 B-PLL。
表型與遺傳：強表現 sIg 與 B 細胞標記，CD5 多為陰性或弱、CD23 多陰性；常見 MYC 異常與 17p/TP53 異常，預後差、對傳統化療反應不佳。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 CLL 合併 prolymphocytes 增加：CLL 背景是大量小型成熟淋巴球加 smudge cells、CD5+/CD23+，prolymphocytes <55%；而 blastoid MCL 形態可完全相同，只能靠 cyclin D1/SOX11 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中這些帶單一明顯核仁的中大型淋巴細胞稱為什麼？在下 B-PLL 診斷前必須用哪個檢查排除何種疾病？
quiz.a: Prolymphocytes；須以 cyclin D1（或 SOX11）IHC/FISH t(11;14) 排除 leukemic mantle cell lymphoma。

60572.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片中許多漿細胞的細胞質內有一個大型透明空泡，把細胞核推擠成新月形貼在細胞邊緣，形似印戒細胞（signet ring）；旁邊仍可見典型核偏位、核旁淡染的漿細胞，且 CD138 瀰漫陽性，證實是漿細胞骨髓瘤而非轉移性印戒細胞癌。
features: Hypercellular marrow particles with numerous vacuolated cells (low power)
Plasma cells with a single large, clear cytoplasmic vacuole compressing the nucleus into a crescent at the periphery (signet ring morphology)
Admixed conventional plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof (open arrows)
Biopsy H&E: sheets of plasma cells with intracytoplasmic clear vacuoles indenting the nucleus
IHC: diffuse strong membranous staining (CD138) of the infiltrate; special stain panels (Ji/Jii) highlight vacuolated cells, PAS/mucin status not determinable from the figure
60572.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show increased plasma cells, many containing a single large clear cytoplasmic vacuole that displaces and compresses the nucleus into a crescent, imparting a signet-ring appearance, admixed with conventional plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs. The core biopsy shows sheets of similar vacuolated plasma cells that are diffusely positive for a plasma cell marker (consistent with CD138). Additional histochemical stains highlight the vacuolated cells, although their specific nature cannot be determined from the figure alone. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with signet ring morphology.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive, mucicarmine positive and keratin positive, and lack CD138 with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction and perinuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Signet ring cell lymphoma (follicular or other B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD20 positive with vacuoles containing immunoglobulin, whereas myeloma cells are CD20 negative, CD138 positive plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Serous fat atrophy/adipocytes or lipid-laden histiocytes
ddx.vs: Adipocytes have a thin rim of cytoplasm with no plasma cell chromatin, and histiocytes have multiple small vacuoles and are CD68/CD163 positive.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are eosinophilic or gray-blue homogeneous globules, not optically clear vacuoles.

60572.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138; special stains

60636.recognize_zh: 抹片同時出現數個有核紅血球、髓細胞與顆粒球左移，另見大小不一的紅血球與少量變形紅血球，呈類似骨髓增生性腫瘤的白血球–紅血球母細胞樣（leukoerythroblastic）變化；需配合鐮狀細胞疾病與小病毒 B19 感染的臨床背景判讀。
features: Several nucleated red blood cells with dense pyknotic nuclei and orthochromatic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Immature granulocytes including a myelocyte and a promyelocyte-like cell with coarse granules, together with segmented neutrophils (left shift)
Large cell with vacuolated granular cytoplasm and immature nucleus (lower center), likely a reactive/immature myeloid cell
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including occasional polychromatophilic cells, target-like forms and a rare elongated cell; few classic sickle cells in this field
Platelets not increased in this field
60636.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with multiple circulating nucleated red cells, immature granulocytes at myelocyte and earlier stages, and mature neutrophils. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with scattered polychromatophilic and target-like forms, although classic sickle cells are few in this field. No definite blasts with Auer rods are identified. In a toddler with sickle cell disease, this pattern can mimic a myeloproliferative neoplasm; parvovirus B19 testing (PCR, bone marrow for giant pronormoblasts) is recommended. Findings are suggestive of a reactive leukoerythroblastic reaction related to parvovirus B19 infection.

ddx.vs: JMML shows persistent monocytosis, splenomegaly, elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations, whereas the parvovirus reaction is transient and lacks clonal genetics.
Clonal MPN/TAM shows blasts, megakaryocytic atypia and a genetic driver (e.g., GATA1, JAK2), whereas parvovirus-associated changes resolve with viral clearance.
Infiltration shows teardrop cells and marrow fibrosis or tumor on biopsy, while parvovirus marrow shows giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions.

ddx.dx: Hyposplenism in sickle cell disease alone
ddx.vs: Sickle hyposplenism causes Howell-Jolly bodies, target cells and few nRBCs but not a marked left shift with immature granulocytes.

60700.recognize_zh: 積液細胞抹片中是大型、核不規則且染色質粗、細胞質深藍的淋巴瘤細胞；流式與免疫染色支持 T 細胞表型，TRG 基因重組呈單株峰，但 IGH (FR3) 也出現單一峰，這是「假單株」結果，不可據此判為 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular/lobated nuclei, coarse chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm among red cells
Panels B-C: flow cytometry dot plots with distinct colored populations (axis labels not legible)
Panel D: IHC with membranous/cytoplasmic granular staining of most large cells (marker unlabeled)
Panel E: strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells (marker unlabeled; pattern fits a high proliferation or transcription marker)
Panel F: IHC essentially negative except rare cells (marker unlabeled)
Panels G-H: capillary electrophoresis showing a dominant TRG peak and a single dominant IGH FR3 peak
60700.describe_en: Cytologic preparation of the effusion shows large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Flow cytometry plots and immunostains (markers not labeled/legible in the figure) characterize the population, with one marker diffusely positive, one showing nuclear positivity in most cells and one negative. Fragment analysis demonstrates a dominant TRG peak as well as a dominant IGH FR3 peak. In context, findings are consistent with a T-cell lymphoma presenting as a primary effusion-based lymphoma, with the IGH peak representing a pseudo-monoclonal result (limited template or cross-lineage rearrangement) that should not override the immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Classic PEL is HHV8/LANA positive with plasmablastic null-cell phenotype and true IG rearrangement, rather than a T-cell phenotype.
This entity expresses B-cell markers (CD20/PAX5) with clonal IG rearrangement that is reproducible, not pseudo-clonal.

ddx.dx: Secondary effusion involvement by systemic PTCL
ddx.vs: Distinguished clinically and radiologically by a nodal or extranodal mass outside the serous cavity.

60444.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin stain）下，脂肪細胞間可見許多黑色細絲狀纖維，彼此分枝交錯形成疏鬆網路（尤其右側與中央），超過正常零散的纖維量；左上方另見棕色含鐵血黃素沉積。這代表輕度網狀纖維化，在 GATA2 缺乏相關的兒童骨髓衰竭／MDS 中常見。
features: Silver-impregnated reticulin fibers visible as thin black branching threads throughout the interstitium
Loose network with frequent intersections around adipocytes and between hematopoietic cells, without collagen bundles (approximately MF-1)
Patchy cellularity with numerous adipocytes; hematopoietic cells show a counterstained pink-red appearance
Golden-brown pigment clumps at upper left, consistent with hemosiderin
No coarse thick fibers or osteosclerosis in this field
60444.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows an increased number of thin, black reticulin fibers forming a loose network with frequent intersections, particularly around adipocytes and within cellular areas. Coarse thick fibers and collagen bundles are not seen, corresponding to mild reticulin fibrosis (approximately MF-1). Hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present at the upper left. In a child with germline GATA2 mutation, monosomy 7 and hypocellular marrow, reticulin fibrosis is a supportive feature of GATA2 deficiency-associated myelodysplasia (refractory cytopenia of childhood).

ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows only scattered linear fibers without intersections, whereas this field shows a branching network with many crossings.

PMF shows dense diffuse fibers (MF-2/3) with collagen, osteosclerosis and clustered bizarre megakaryocytes in a usually hypercellular marrow, unlike the mild fibrosis in a hypocellular pediatric marrow here.
Aplastic anemia typically lacks increased reticulin; significant reticulin fibrosis in a hypocellular marrow favors hypocellular MDS/GATA2 deficiency.

60188.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央是一顆循環芽細胞：比淋巴球略大、核質比很高、染色質細緻均勻並有淡色核仁、周圍只有一圈藍色無顆粒胞質；在全血球減少病人的周邊血看到芽細胞，要想到MDS伴過多芽細胞。
features: Single circulating blast of intermediate size, larger than a small lymphocyte
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis (occasional elliptocytes/teardrop forms); platelets sparse
60188.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast of intermediate size with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, faint nucleoli and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods are identified. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes, and platelets are sparse. Dysplastic neutrophils are not captured in this field. In a pancytopenic patient with 2% circulating blasts, these findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts, and bone marrow examination with flow cytometry is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin without the fine blastic pattern.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and mature clumped chromatin.
AML is defined by ≥20% blasts in blood or marrow, whereas rare blasts with pancytopenia favor MDS pending marrow count.
Lymphoma cells often have cleaved or irregular nuclei with coarser chromatin and show a mature B- or T-cell phenotype rather than CD34/CD117 positivity.

60124.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片白血球與血小板都很少，整個視野只見一顆中性球與一顆淋巴球，紅血球大致正球性、偶見多染性紅血球，沒有明顯裂片紅血球或球形紅血球；PNH 抹片型態不具特異性，需以流式檢測 GPI 錨定蛋白確診。
features: Leukopenia: only one segmented neutrophil and one lymphocyte in a wide field
Thrombocytopenia with rare platelets
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis
Occasional polychromatophilic red cell, reflecting reticulocytosis
No significant schistocytes, spherocytes or circulating blasts
60124.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows pancytopenia, with only rare neutrophils and lymphocytes and markedly decreased platelets in this field. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and occasional polychromatophilic cells, and there are no significant schistocytes, spherocytes, dysplastic neutrophils or circulating blasts. The smear morphology is nonspecific; in a young adult with pancytopenia and a relatively preserved reticulocyte count, findings are compatible with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, which should be confirmed by high-sensitivity flow cytometry (FLAER, CD59, CD24/CD14).

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia also shows pancytopenia but with an inappropriately low reticulocyte count; PNH clones may coexist and are detected only by flow cytometry.
MDS often shows macrocytosis, hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and dysplastic features, which are absent here.
AIHA typically shows spherocytes and a positive DAT without neutropenia and thrombocytopenia, whereas PNH is DAT-negative.

60060.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現高核質比、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質僅剩一圈淡藍色的母細胞（blasts），同時背景血小板與白血球都很少；單看型態無法分辨 B 淋巴母細胞或骨髓母細胞，須靠流式確認，此例為 Ph+ B-ALL。
features: Circulating blasts with very high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei round (right panel) to irregular/angular (left, larger cell) with fine, homogeneous chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background shows few platelets and no mature leukocytes in these fields, consistent with pancytopenia
Red cells largely normocytic with mild anisocytosis and an occasional echinocyte
60060.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating blasts in a background with markedly reduced platelets and leukocytes. The blasts are small to intermediate in size, with very high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a scant rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Red cells show mild anisocytosis without significant schistocytes or nucleated red cells. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with peripheral blood involvement; morphology does not permit lineage assignment, and flow cytometry demonstrating a B-lymphoblast phenotype with BCR::ABL1 on cytogenetics supports Ph-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML with minimal differentiation also has agranular blasts without Auer rods; separation requires flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 without B-lineage markers) rather than morphology.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin, and hematogones are rare in blood and show a maturing, non-aberrant immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of large B-cell or mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells usually have more clumped chromatin, visible nucleoli or nuclear clefts, and a mature TdT-negative, surface light chain restricted phenotype.
Also BCR::ABL1-positive; suggested by basophilia, left-shifted granulocytes, and p210 transcript, features not present in this pancytopenic smear.

27676.recognize_zh: 原發腫瘤切片為一致的小圓細胞實性片狀生長；骨髓抹片中出現成群、細胞質淡藍、核圓且染色質呈顆粒狀（鹽與胡椒樣）的非造血細胞，易被誤認為芽細胞或漿細胞，免疫細胞化學在細胞質呈陽性並帶樹突狀突起——符合轉移性甲狀腺髓質癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheets of monotonous small round-to-spindled tumor cells with a fibrous capsule and adjacent fat
Panels B–C (smear): clusters of medium-to-large non-hematopoietic cells with round, often eccentric nuclei
Coarsely granular 'salt-and-pepper' chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm, some with fine pink granules; loose cohesion
Panels D–E (immunocytochemistry): strong cytoplasmic brown staining with dendritic cytoplasmic processes (marker not labeled; likely calcitonin/neuroendocrine marker)
27676.describe_en: Panel A shows a solid, cellular neoplasm composed of monotonous small cells in sheets with a fibrous capsule. Bone marrow aspirate smears (B, C) contain clusters of medium-to-large, loosely cohesive non-hematopoietic cells with round eccentric nuclei, finely granular neuroendocrine-type chromatin and pale cytoplasm, some with fine pink granules; at low power these cells mimic plasma cells or blasts. Immunocytochemistry on the smear (D, E) shows strong cytoplasmic staining with dendritic processes. In a patient with a thyroid primary, the findings are consistent with bone marrow metastasis of medullary thyroid carcinoma; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells show clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD138/light chain-restricted rather than calcitonin/chromogranin-positive.
Blasts are non-cohesive with fine open chromatin and nucleoli, and are CD45/CD34-positive and keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma or neuroblastoma
ddx.vs: Share neuroendocrine markers, but show nuclear molding and scant cytoplasm (small cell) or rosettes in children (neuroblastoma), and lack calcitonin/CEA expression.
Lobular carcinoma cells form single files, are GATA3/ER-positive, E-cadherin-negative and neuroendocrine marker-negative.

2972.recognize_zh: 這是低倍的骨髓抹片：背景為大量散在的有核細胞與紅血球，右側有一大團緊密聚集的深藍色細胞團（骨髓小粒/細胞聚集），另見少數較大的單顆細胞（可能為巨核細胞或組織球）；此倍率無法確認噬血現象，需高倍檢視骨髓小粒周邊的組織球。
features: Low-power view of an aspirate smear with a dense, darkly staining cellular aggregate/particle at right
Smaller cellular cluster near the top edge of the smear
Scattered larger single cells (possible megakaryocytes or histiocytes) in the cellular trails
Diffuse background of nucleated cells and red cells
Hemophagocytic histiocytes cannot be resolved at this magnification
2972.describe_en: Low-power examination of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a dense aggregate of hematopoietic cells and a smaller cluster near the feathered edge, along with scattered larger single cells in the cellular trails. Individual cell morphology, including the presence of phagocytosed blood cells within histiocytes, cannot be assessed at this magnification. The image is useful to locate particles and cellular areas where high-power search for hemophagocytic histiocytes should be performed. Diagnosis of hemophagocytic syndrome requires high-power confirmation and correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive with large cells and molding at high power, which cannot be excluded at this magnification and requires closer examination.
Clotted areas contain fibrin and platelet clumps and distort cells, whereas intact particles show preserved stroma and fat with hematopoietic cells.

20380.recognize_zh: 抹片中可見一顆破裂的巨噬細胞周圍散布許多 2–4 µm 的小圓形藍紫色小體（A），以及另一顆細胞內含數個相同小體（B），這些是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote），符合內臟利什曼病；但此視野紅血球單層排列，外觀較像血液抹片或骨髓抹片的稀薄區。
features: Numerous small (about 2-4 µm) round-to-oval dark-staining bodies clustered within and around a disrupted macrophage (panel A)
A second cell containing several similar intracellular bodies (panel B)
Individual organisms too small at this resolution to confirm the nucleus-kinetoplast pair reliably
Adjacent intact mononuclear cells without organisms
Monolayer red cells with sparse nucleated cells, giving a blood-film-like background
20380.describe_en: The smear shows a disrupted macrophage with numerous small round-to-oval intracellular and extruded organisms measuring roughly 2-4 µm, and a second cell containing several similar bodies; adjacent mononuclear cells lack organisms. At this resolution the characteristic nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast of each organism are not clearly resolved. The field has sparse nucleated cells in a red cell monolayer, resembling a peripheral blood film or a thin area of an aspirate smear rather than a cellular marrow particle. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes and support visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by PCR, culture, or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size within macrophages but have a surrounding clear halo and lack a kinetoplast, and stain with GMS/PAS, which Leishmania does not.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a kinetoplast and are rarely seen in marrow macrophages.
Superimposed platelets are granular, irregular, and lie in a different focal plane, lacking the discrete nucleus-plus-kinetoplast structure.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by central transverse septation and lack a kinetoplast.

exam.answer_en: Leishmania amastigotes (visceral leishmaniasis) — ruptured macrophage with numerous extruded 2–4 µm organisms; kinetoplasts not resolved in this field
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指破裂巨噬細胞周圍散落的小體，問「這是什麼、還需要看什麼特徵才能確定」；答案 Leishman-Donovan bodies，需在高倍確認 nucleus + kinetoplast。
本圖為紅血球單層的稀薄區，外觀像血液抹片；免疫低下（如 HIV）病人病原體量高時，周邊血 buffy coat 也可找到 amastigotes。
確認：PCR、培養（NNN medium）、血清學（rK39）；脾臟抽吸敏感度最高但有出血風險，骨髓抽吸較安全為常用首選。
臨床：發燒、脾腫大、全血球低下、高 γ-globulin 血症；可繼發 HLH。治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B。
exam.pitfall_zh: 當 kinetoplast 看不清時，易與 Histoplasma、Talaromyces marneffei 或疊在巨噬細胞上的血小板混淆；可加做 GMS（真菌陽性、Leishmania 陰性）或 PCR 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中破裂巨噬細胞周圍散落的 2–4 µm 小圓體最可能是什麼？若要與 Histoplasma 區分，高倍下需找到哪個構造？
quiz.a: Leishmania amastigotes（Leishman-Donovan bodies）；棒狀的 kinetoplast。

17948.recognize_zh: 這是基因資料圖而非形態圖：A、B 為中度細胞遺傳風險 AML 的 Circos 共突變圖（FLT3、NPM1、DNMT3A 弧最寬），C 為依 FLT3-ITD 有無分層的存活曲線，IDH/NPM1 共突變預後佳，TET2、ASXL1、PHF6、MLL-PTD 預後差。
features: Composite data figure, not a morphologic image
Panels A-B: Circos plots of co-occurring mutations in cytogenetically intermediate-risk AML
Dominant ribbons involve FLT3, NPM1 and DNMT3A; smaller segments include TET2, ASXL1, RUNX1, WT1, RAS, IDH, CEBPA, MLL-PTD
Panel C top: FLT3-ITD-negative cases, mutant NPM1 with IDH1/IDH2 show best overall survival; TET2/ASXL1/PHF6/MLL-PTD show worst
Panel C bottom: FLT3-ITD-positive cases, CEBPA mutation favorable; TET2, DNMT3A, MLL-PTD or trisomy 8 unfavorable
17948.describe_en: This composite figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) displays mutational data in AML with intermediate-risk cytogenetics. Circos plots in panels A and B show patterns of co-occurring mutations in patients with intermediate versus unfavorable mutational risk profiles, with prominent involvement of FLT3, NPM1 and DNMT3A. Panel C shows Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves stratified by FLT3-ITD status, demonstrating that NPM1 plus IDH mutations confer favorable outcome in FLT3-ITD-negative disease, whereas TET2, ASXL1, PHF6, MLL-PTD or DNMT3A mutations define poorer outcomes. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

13020.recognize_zh: AIDS 患者的血液抹片中，中性球（A）與單核球／巨噬細胞（B）的細胞質內塞滿許多 2–4 µm 的小型卵圓形酵母菌，每個有偏心新月形的染色質與周圍透明暈（pseudocapsule），符合播散性組織漿菌症（disseminated histoplasmosis）。
features: Numerous small (2-4 µm) oval intracellular yeasts within neutrophils (panel A) and a monocyte/macrophage (panel B)
Each yeast has an eccentric crescent of dark-staining chromatin
Clear halo (pseudocapsule) surrounding each organism
No budding on broad bases or hyphae visible; organisms are uniform in size
A few extracellular yeasts adjacent to the ruptured/host cell; background leukocytes and red cells
13020.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils and a monocyte/macrophage containing numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 µm. Each organism has an eccentric crescent-shaped chromatin mass and a surrounding clear halo (pseudocapsule), and some lie extracellularly adjacent to the host cell. No hyphae or pseudohyphae are identified. In a severely immunosuppressed patient with pancytopenia and hepatosplenomegaly, findings are consistent with disseminated Histoplasma capsulatum infection; fungal culture, GMS/PAS stains, and urine antigen testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Talaromyces yeasts are similar in size but divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are elongated or sausage-shaped rather than budding oval forms.
Leishmania amastigotes contain a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and lack a clear pseudocapsular halo.
Candida yeasts are larger (3-6 µm), stain more deeply without a halo, and often show budding with pseudohyphae.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic with central nuclei, while Cryptococcus is larger (4-10 µm) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — small 2–4 µm oval yeasts with crescent chromatin and clear halo inside neutrophils and monocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指著中性球或單核球內的小卵圓顆粒問是什麼病原；周邊血看得到代表播散性、高菌量感染，多見於 AIDS 等嚴重免疫抑制。
確診：尿液或血清 Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高；組織以 GMS、PAS 染色，另送真菌培養；在周邊血見到菌可先依型態啟動治療。
治療：中重度播散性感染先用 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，再以 itraconazole 維持；HIV 病人需同時開始 ART。
臨床連結：常合併全血球減少、肝脾腫大與 LDH 升高，且可誘發噬血症候群（HLH），在 HLH 檢查中要想到此病原。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Talaromyces marneffei（台灣與東南亞重要）或 Leishmania 混淆；T. marneffei 以橫隔分裂（septum）、無出芽，Leishmania 有 kinetoplast，Histoplasma 則為窄基出芽且有透明暈。

quiz.q: AIDS 病人中性球內 2–4 µm、帶透明暈的小酵母菌，最快速的非侵入性確診檢查為何？
quiz.a: 尿液（或血清）Histoplasma antigen

13852.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血視野中散佈十個左右的顆粒性單核細胞，核圓至卵圓或輕度雙葉，胞質充滿深紫色異染性顆粒，部分顆粒稀少或散落周圍；循環中出現這麼多肥大細胞，符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: Numerous circulating granulated mononuclear cells scattered across a low-power field
Round to oval, occasionally bilobed or indented nuclei partly obscured by granules
Dark purple metachromatic cytoplasmic granules of variable density; some cells hypogranular
Granules dispersed around several cells, consistent with degranulation
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including occasional echinocytes, stomatocyte-like and elliptical forms
13852.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating granulated mononuclear cells with round to oval or bilobed nuclei and variably dense dark purple metachromatic granules, several with dispersed granules at the cell periphery. Some cells are hypogranular, a feature of atypical mast cells. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic mast cells, supporting mast cell leukemia (leukemic variant); confirmation by flow cytometry for CD117, CD25 and CD2, serum tryptase, marrow examination and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei and are CD117-negative, and CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic series with BCR::ABL1.
Basophilic blasts are immature with nucleoli and lack tryptase and CD25 expression and KIT D816V.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: This entity may show atypical mast cells but is dominated by eosinophilia and defined by FIP1L1::PDGFRA on FISH or RT-PCR.

12508.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片中造血組織被多個淡色、放射狀排列成花束或玫瑰花形的結晶取代，周圍有組織球與多核巨細胞及纖維化；B 圖偏光下結晶呈強烈雙折射，符合草酸鹽沉積症（oxalosis）侵犯骨髓。
features: A: multiple pale, radially arranged, sheaf- or rosette-like crystalline deposits within the marrow space
A: crystals surrounded by histiocytes and multinucleated foreign-body giant cells with fibrotic stroma
A: irregular, remodeled bony trabeculae; normal hematopoietic tissue largely absent
B: under polarized light, crystals show strong birefringence in radiating needle-like clusters
No granulomas with necrosis or tumor cells identified
12508.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows replacement of hematopoietic marrow by numerous pale, radially arranged, rosette- and sheaf-like crystalline deposits surrounded by histiocytes, foreign-body giant cells, and fibrosis, with irregular remodeled bony trabeculae. Under polarized light, the crystals are strongly birefringent with a radiating needle-like arrangement. No hematopoietic neoplasm is identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis (calcium oxalate crystal deposition) causing marrow failure, as seen in primary hyperoxaluria or end-stage renal disease; correlation with renal function and plasma/urine oxalate is recommended.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are dissolved by aqueous fixation, leaving amorphous material, and are negatively birefringent needles rather than rosettes of oxalate.
Granulomas show epithelioid histiocyte clusters without abundant birefringent crystal rosettes.
Calcium phosphate deposits are basophilic, non-birefringent and von Kossa positive rather than refractile birefringent crystals.
Immunoglobulin crystals are intracytoplasmic eosinophilic rods within histiocytes, not large extracellular radiating rosettes.

11292.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，嗜中性球不散開而是成團聚集在抹片邊緣附近（neutrophil aggregates），其餘區域幾乎看不到白血球，這種體外聚集會使自動計數器低估白血球。
features: Low-power field with two large aggregates of segmented neutrophils near the feathered edge
Few individually dispersed leukocytes elsewhere in the smear
Aggregated cells retain normal segmented nuclear morphology
Monolayer red cells without agglutination
Magnification limits assessment of platelets and cytoplasmic detail
11292.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows clusters of segmented neutrophils aggregated near the feathered edge, with very few single leukocytes dispersed across the remainder of the field. The red cells form an even monolayer without agglutination. Detailed cytology and platelet assessment are limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil aggregation, which can cause a spuriously low automated neutrophil and white cell count; scanning the feathered edge and repeating the count on a non-EDTA sample are recommended.

ddx.vs: True neutropenia shows few neutrophils uniformly throughout the smear, including the feathered edge, without clustered aggregates.
Platelet clumps are aggregates of small anucleate fragments, whereas these clusters are composed of nucleated segmented neutrophils.
Cold agglutinins cause irregular red cell clumps with a spurious macrocytosis, not aggregates of leukocytes.

3612.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓顆粒富含細胞，其中散布許多明顯較大、深染的圓形巨核細胞，數量比預期多，這是 ITP 骨髓中巨核細胞增加的表現；低倍無法評估其成熟度。
features: Low-power view of cellular marrow particles with interspersed fat spaces
Numerous large, round, darker cells scattered within and around the particles, consistent with megakaryocytes
Megakaryocyte number appears increased for the particle area, without tight clustering
Dense background of smaller hematopoietic cells spread around the particles
Cytologic detail of megakaryocyte maturation cannot be assessed at this magnification
3612.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows cellular particles with interspersed fat spaces and abundant trail cellularity. Megakaryocytes are readily identified as numerous large dark cells scattered through the particles and appear increased in number. Individual megakaryocyte morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with the increased megakaryocytes typical of immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MPNs show increased megakaryocytes that are large and hyperlobated (ET) or form tight atypical clusters (PMF), usually with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS may have normal or increased megakaryocytes but with dysplastic hypolobated or separated-lobe forms and dysplasia in other lineages, which requires high-power review.

ddx.dx: Hypersplenism or consumptive thrombocytopenia (e.g. DIC, TTP)
ddx.vs: These also show increased megakaryocytes with peripheral destruction, so separation from ITP relies on clinical findings, splenomegaly, schistocytes and coagulation studies.

1372.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型未成熟巨核細胞，核單一、未分葉，胞質嗜鹼性偏藍並在邊緣有細顆粒與胞質出芽（cytoplasmic budding）；ITP 骨髓常見此類年輕巨核細胞增加，反映周邊破壞下的代償性增生。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a single large, non-lobated to minimally lobated oval nucleus
Nucleus with coarse, open chromatin, eccentrically placed
Moderate lilac-blue cytoplasm with fine granularity and irregular peripheral cytoplasmic budding
No overt platelet shedding or separated nuclear lobes
Background of maturing neutrophils, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and red cells; slide text label describes the finding
1372.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large immature megakaryocyte with a single, minimally lobated nucleus and moderate basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm with peripheral budding, surrounded by unremarkable maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The embedded slide caption notes that young megakaryocytes are increased in number. In the setting of isolated thrombocytopenia, increased numbers of megakaryocytes including immature forms are consistent with compensatory megakaryopoiesis in immune thrombocytopenia, although this finding is not specific.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) megakaryocytes are small-to-medium with non-lobated round nuclei and mature cytoplasm, accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and clonal cytogenetics.
Smaller blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and cytoplasmic blebs, present in increased numbers with CD41/CD61 positivity.
Cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and nucleoli, lacking megakaryocytic granular cytoplasm.

1308.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中充滿一致的中型腫瘤細胞，細胞質深藍並含小而清楚的脂質空泡，核圓、有數個小核仁，背景大量凋亡細胞核碎片，符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤的高增生形態。
features: Monotonous population of medium-sized discohesive lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and several small nucleoli
Punched-out clear cytoplasmic (lipid) vacuoles in many cells
Abundant apoptotic cells and karyorrhectic nuclear fragments in the background
Scattered red cells; no mesothelial or epithelial clusters
1308.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of ascitic fluid is highly cellular, containing a monotonous population of medium-sized discohesive lymphoid cells. The cells have round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and multiple small nucleoli, and scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply defined clear vacuoles. Numerous apoptotic cells and nuclear fragments are present in the background, reflecting high cell turnover. No cohesive epithelial or mesothelial groups are identified. Findings are consistent with involvement by Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+, BCL2-negative, Ki-67 near 100%) and MYC rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (including high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements)
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with less uniform vacuolation; separation from double-hit lymphoma requires BCL2 expression and FISH.
Lymphoblasts have finer blastic chromatin, scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm and are TdT+/surface Ig-negative, unlike TdT-negative, surface Ig-positive Burkitt cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with larger nuclei and are keratin-positive.
Mesothelial cells have dense two-tone cytoplasm with 'windows' and macrophages have foamy cytoplasm with bean-shaped nuclei, lacking a monotonous basophilic population.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma in ascitic fluid — monotonous medium-sized cells with deeply basophilic, lipid-vacuolated cytoplasm and abundant apoptotic debris
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著胞質深藍、有 punched-out 空泡的細胞問診斷與空泡內容；答 Burkitt lymphoma，空泡為脂質（Oil Red O 陽性），背景凋亡碎片反映極高增殖與凋亡。
表型：CD19+、CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2 陰性或弱、TdT−、表面 Ig 輕鏈限制；Ki-67 接近 100%。
遺傳：MYC 重排，最常 t(8;14)(q24;q32) IGH::MYC，少數 t(2;8) 或 t(8;22)；若同時有 BCL2 重排則應歸 HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements。
急症：腫瘤倍增快，治療前後高風險 tumor lysis syndrome，須積極水分、rasburicase 與電解質監測；治療用高強度化療含 CNS prophylaxis（如 DA-EPOCH-R、CODOX-M/IVAC）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 B-lymphoblastic leukemia（舊稱 FAB L3 即 Burkitt）：B-ALL 為 TdT+、常 CD34+、表面 Ig 陰性；Burkitt 為 TdT−、表面 Ig+ 的成熟 B 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞胞質空泡內含何種物質？最典型的染色體異常為何？
quiz.a: 脂質（lipid，Oil Red O 陽性）；t(8;14)(q24;q32) IGH::MYC

1180.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一個圓形、極深染且幾乎無細胞質的巨核細胞裸核，下方連著成群血小板碎片；上方可見一顆與紅血球等大的巨大血小板，背景紅血球大小不一並有少數淚滴細胞，提示骨髓纖維化。
features: Round, very dense, hyperchromatic naked megakaryocyte nucleus with minimal cytoplasm
Platelet fragments clustered at the edge of the bare nucleus
Giant platelet approaching the size of a red cell with pale, finely granular cytoplasm
Anisocytosis with occasional teardrop cells, a large polychromatic cell and elliptocytes
Scattered normal-sized platelets
1180.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild to moderate anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop cells, elliptocytes and a large polychromatophilic red cell. A small, round, hyperchromatic nucleus with minimal cytoplasm and adherent platelet fragments is present, consistent with a circulating naked megakaryocyte nucleus. A giant platelet approximately the size of a red cell is also seen. Findings are consistent with the peripheral blood picture of primary myelofibrosis, with correlation with marrow biopsy and MPN driver mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes show a visible rim of blue cytoplasm and less opaque chromatin, and lack attached budding platelet fragments.
A normoblast has a small pyknotic nucleus surrounded by pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not platelet fragments.
ET shows giant platelets and thrombocytosis but lacks teardrop poikilocytosis and circulating megakaryocyte nuclei.
Marrow infiltration by tumor or granulomas gives the same leukoerythroblastic features; distinction requires marrow biopsy.

exam.answer_en: Myelofibrosis, peripheral blood — hyperchromatic naked megakaryocyte nucleus with platelet fragments, a giant platelet and teardrop cells
pearls_zh: 考法：這張有兩個指點目標：下方深染裸核（naked megakaryocyte nucleus）與上方和紅血球等大的 giant platelet，考官會要你各說出名稱並連結 MPN/myelofibrosis。
Giant platelet 定義為與紅血球大小相近或更大，見於 MPN、MDS 及遺傳性巨大血小板症（如 Bernard-Soulier、MYH9-related disorders），需結合臨床判讀。
PMF 常見周邊血：leukoerythroblastosis、dacrocytes、大型血小板、裸核；脾腫大源於 extramedullary hematopoiesis。
Overt PMF 的診斷需骨髓切片 reticulin 纖維化 MF-2/3、異型巨核細胞，以及 JAK2/CALR/MPL 或其他 clonal marker，並排除其他 myeloid 腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 裸核常被誤認為有核紅血球（orthochromatic normoblast）：NRBC 核圓而正、周圍有粉紅至多染性胞質；巨核細胞裸核幾乎無胞質且邊緣黏附血小板碎片。

quiz.q: 圖上方與紅血球等大的血小板稱為什麼？下方深染無胞質的核又是什麼？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；naked megakaryocyte nucleus

1116.recognize_zh: 成群的中型母細胞，胞質深藍色並充滿圓形清楚的空泡（cytoplasmic vacuoles），染色質細緻，這是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤/白血病（舊稱 L3）的典型外觀。
features: Sheets and clusters of medium-sized, monomorphic blasts
Round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles
Many cells with vacuoles overlying the nucleus as well as cytoplasm
Scattered bare/smudged nuclei in the background
1116.describe_en: The smear is replaced by clusters and sheets of monomorphic medium-sized blasts. The cells have round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete, punched-out vacuoles. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires a mature B-cell phenotype (CD10+, BCL2-negative, surface light chain restricted, Ki-67 ~100%) and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without prominent vacuolation, are TdT positive and lack surface light chain.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: These are more pleomorphic with larger nuclei and prominent nucleoli and typically express BCL2; FISH for MYC/BCL2/BCL6 separates them.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with vacuolated cytoplasm
ddx.vs: Monoblasts have gray-blue, more abundant cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive rather than B-cell marker positive.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma — monomorphic medium-sized blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著空泡化母細胞問「FAB 舊分類是哪一型？要驗什麼基因？」答 L3，驗 MYC 重組（t(8;14) 最常見，另 t(2;8)、t(8;22)）。
表型：成熟 B 細胞 CD19+、CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、surface Ig 輕鏈限制；TdT 陰性、BCL2 陰性或弱；Ki-67 接近 100%。
急症：腫瘤倍增極快，化療前後易發生 tumor lysis syndrome（高鉀、高磷、高尿酸、低鈣、急性腎損傷），需積極水化與 rasburicase。
胞質空泡為脂質，Oil red O 陽性；組織切片則呈 starry-sky 樣（tingible-body macrophages）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 B-ALL 混淆；Burkitt 為 TdT 陰性、表面輕鏈限制的成熟 B 表型並有 MYC 重組，B-ALL 則 TdT+、CD34 常陽性且無表面 Ig；空泡也可見於部分 ALL，不能單靠形態。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質深藍帶清楚空泡的母細胞，最常見的染色體轉位是什麼？
