1052.recognize_zh: 低倍下整張抹片布滿大小不一、形狀不規則的紅血球團塊，均勻分布於全視野而非只在厚區，這種瀰漫性凝集是冷凝集素的典型低倍表現。
features: Diffuse red cell agglutination: numerous irregular clumps of red cells distributed evenly across the smear at low power
Clumps vary in size and have irregular, branching outlines rather than linear stacks
Intervening single red cells present between clumps
Scattered leukocytes with no obvious increase at this magnification; individual cell detail limited by low power
1052.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows diffuse red cell agglutination, with innumerable irregular clumps of red cells scattered uniformly throughout the monolayer. The clumps are irregular and branching rather than linear rouleaux. Scattered leukocytes are present; detailed cytologic assessment is not possible at this magnification. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated red cell agglutination, as seen in cold agglutinin disease.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux appear as linear coin stacks with an associated bluish proteinaceous background, whereas this smear shows irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with an IgG-positive DAT and generally lacks diffuse macroscopic agglutination.
PCH is caused by the biphasic IgG Donath-Landsteiner antibody and usually shows erythrophagocytosis rather than prominent agglutination.

4188.recognize_zh: 視野中數個中型淋巴球核呈分葉或扭曲狀（類似花瓣的 flower cell），與小而圓的正常淋巴球並存，配合 HTLV-1 即可指向成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, lobulated to convoluted nuclei (flower-cell-like)
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small round mature-appearing lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil
Several smudged/crushed lymphoid cells with clear cytoplasmic halos
Background RBCs with mild anisopoikilocytosis
4188.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased lymphoid cells, including medium-sized forms with irregular lobulated or convoluted nuclei, condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small round lymphocytes. A segmented neutrophil and several partially disrupted lymphoid cells are present. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. The polylobated nuclear morphology is suggestive of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than distinct petal-like lobes, and are HTLV-1 negative.
T-PLL cells have round nuclei with a visible nucleolus and basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs RBCs and lack clover-leaf nuclear lobation.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — circulating medium-sized lymphocytes with lobulated, flower-like nuclei (HTLV-1 associated)
pearls_zh: 考法：指分葉扭曲核的淋巴球問名稱與病原。答 flower cells，ATLL，HTLV-1。
Flow 表型：CD3+、CD4+、CD25 強陽性、CD7−、CD26−，常 CCR4+（anti-CCR4 抗體 mogamulizumab 的標靶）。
確診：HTLV-1 血清抗體陽性，並證明 HTLV-1 provirus 在腫瘤細胞為 monoclonal integration。
Shimoyama 分型：acute、lymphoma、chronic、smoldering；acute 型常有高血鈣、LDH 升高、皮膚病灶與伺機感染（如 Strongyloides hyperinfection、PJP）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Sézary syndrome 混淆：Sézary cells 為細溝紋的 cerebriform 核、HTLV-1 陰性且常 CD26−/CD7− 但 CD25 較弱；ATLL 為花瓣狀分葉核、CD25 強陽性並有 HTLV-1。

quiz.q: 圖中分葉核淋巴球的慣用名稱為何？與哪一種病毒相關？
quiz.a: Flower cells；HTLV-1

3996.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央組織球淡染的細胞質內充滿數十個大小一致、約 2–3 µm 的小圓形點狀體，成群聚集，即 Leishman-Donovan bodies；H&E 下看不到動基體，需 Giemsa 或 PCR 確認。
features: Central histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with numerous uniform tiny round bodies (~2–3 µm)
Additional histiocytes with granular dot-like inclusions in the upper field
Scattered plasma cells, lymphocytes and erythroid/myeloid precursors
Edematous, poorly fixed marrow with vacuolated stroma; out-of-focus tissue fold on the left
Kinetoplast not visible at this resolution
3996.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows edematous, poorly preserved marrow with scattered plasma cells, lymphocytes and hematopoietic precursors. A centrally located histiocyte contains numerous uniform, round intracytoplasmic bodies approximately 2–3 µm in diameter, and similar inclusions are present in adjacent histiocytes. The nucleus and kinetoplast of the organisms cannot be resolved on this section. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (Leishmania amastigotes) of visceral leishmaniasis in an HIV-infected patient; confirmation by Giemsa-stained aspirate, culture or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a pericellular halo, no kinetoplast, and positive GMS/PAS staining.
Talaromyces yeasts are GMS-positive with a central transverse septum rather than a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma bradyzoites lack a kinetoplast and are confirmed by Toxoplasma immunostain.
Apoptotic debris varies in size and density rather than forming uniform ovoid bodies.

4060.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍下，真皮內有多個緻密、邊界清楚的淋巴球浸潤，集中圍繞血管與附屬器（perivascular/periadnexal），表皮大致未受侵犯；需結合血液中 T-PLL 病史與免疫染色確認。
features: Dense nodular lymphoid infiltrates in superficial and mid dermis
Perivascular and periadnexal distribution around vessels and eccrine structures
Infiltrates composed of small to medium dark lymphoid cells at this power
Interstitial scattered lymphocytes between dermal collagen bundles
Epidermis largely intact without obvious epidermotropism at this magnification
4060.describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows multiple dense, sharply circumscribed lymphoid infiltrates centered on dermal blood vessels and adnexal structures in the superficial and mid dermis, with lighter interstitial infiltration. The overlying epidermis is largely intact and no epidermotropism is evident at this magnification. Cytologic detail is limited at this power. In a patient with known T-prolymphocytic leukemia and a matching T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by T-PLL.

ddx.vs: CLL skin infiltrates are also perivascular/periadnexal but are CD20+/CD5+/CD23+ B cells rather than TCL1+ T cells.
MF shows epidermotropism with Pautrier microabscesses and band-like dermal infiltrate rather than nodular perivascular aggregates.
Reactive infiltrates are sparser, polymorphous and accompanied by interface or epidermal changes without monotonous atypical T cells.

3868.recognize_zh: 細胞密集的骨髓切片中央有一片界線不清的淡粉紅區域，裡面是退化的細胞碎屑與零散組織球，而不是緊密的類上皮細胞結節；這種鬆散、帶壞死感的肉芽腫，符合免疫低下病人播散性組織漿菌病（Histoplasma）的表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a central ill-defined pale zone replacing hematopoietic cells
Pale zone contains eosinophilic granular debris, scattered degenerating cells and loosely arranged histiocytes (necrotizing, poorly formed granuloma)
No compact epithelioid granuloma or multinucleated giant cells in this field
Surrounding marrow shows crowded mixed hematopoietic precursors and scattered fat spaces; bony trabecula at lower right
Intracellular yeasts are not resolvable at this magnification
3868.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) is hypercellular with an ill-defined pale area in which hematopoietic elements are replaced by granular eosinophilic debris, degenerating cells and loosely aggregated histiocytes, forming a poorly formed necrotizing granulomatous focus. Well-formed epithelioid granulomas and giant cells are not seen in this field, and organisms cannot be resolved at this power. In the clinical setting of Histoplasma sepsis, findings are consistent with a necrotizing granulomatous marrow reaction to disseminated histoplasmosis; GMS/PAS stains and high-power examination for 2–4 µm intracellular yeasts are recommended.

ddx.vs: Can look identical on H&E; acid-fast staining and culture/PCR identify mycobacteria, whereas GMS/PAS show small budding yeasts in histoplasmosis.

ddx.dx: Marrow necrosis due to malignancy or sickle crisis
ddx.vs: Ischemic or tumor necrosis shows ghost cells without a histiocytic rim and has no organisms on special stains.
Sarcoid granulomas are compact, non-necrotizing epithelioid nodules with giant cells, and special stains for organisms are negative.

3740.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有數顆中型淋巴球，核圓形、染色質均勻，細胞質淡灰藍且邊緣長出一圈細毛狀突起（hairy projections），是毛細胞白血病的典型樣子。
features: Three medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Round to oval nuclei with evenly dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate N:C ratio
One cell at right lacks projections and has clumped chromatin (likely a normal lymphocyte); red cells with rouleaux-like stacking in thick area
3740.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. A separate small lymphocyte lacks these projections. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD25/CD123 negative, whereas these cells lack visible nucleoli.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar (bipolar) villi and more condensed chromatin rather than circumferential fine projections.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so immunophenotype (CD25-, CD103 often -, annexin A1-) and BRAF wild type separate it from HCL.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia, peripheral blood — medium lymphoid cells with homogeneous chromatin and circumferential fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會讓你比較左邊有毛狀突起的細胞與右邊正常小淋巴球，問「哪些是 hairy cells、下一步做什麼」，答 flow cytometry 與 BRAF V600E。
Flow 表型：CD19/CD20 強陽性、CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 陽性，CD200 強陽性，CD5 與 CD10 多陰性；IHC 以 annexin A1 最特異。
分子：classic HCL 幾乎都有 BRAF V600E；若無 BRAF V600E，要考慮 HCL variant（WHO 5th 歸入 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）或 MAP2K1 突變病例。
臨床：脾腫大、全血球低下且特徵性 monocytopenia，骨髓因 reticulin fibrosis 常 dry tap；一線治療為 purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin）± rituximab。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 splenic marginal zone lymphoma 的 villous lymphocyte；SMZL 突起短而集中於一極或兩極、染色質較粗，HCL 突起細長且環繞整圈、染色質均勻。

quiz.q: 圖中這些毛狀細胞，CBC 上哪一種白血球特徵性地減少？
quiz.a: 單核球（monocytopenia）

3804.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中有一個淡染的結節狀聚集，由細胞質淡而透亮、核卵圓或梭形的細胞組成，周圍混有許多嗜酸性球與纖維化，符合肥大細胞聚集侵犯淋巴結。
features: Central pale nodular aggregate of cells with clear to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Aggregate cells have oval to spindled nuclei with bland chromatin
Surrounding mixed infiltrate rich in eosinophils with collagen/fibrosis
Residual small lymphocytes and plasma cells in the periphery
Nodal architecture effaced in this field; cytoplasmic granules not resolvable on H&E
3804.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a well-circumscribed pale nodular aggregate composed of cells with oval to spindled nuclei and abundant pale to clear cytoplasm. The aggregate is surrounded by a mixed infiltrate containing numerous eosinophils, small lymphocytes and fibrosis, with effacement of normal architecture in this field. Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by systemic mastocytosis; immunohistochemistry for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 and KIT D816V testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Epithelioid granulomas have plump epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells that are CD68+ but tryptase and CD25 negative.
Langerhans cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei and are CD1a+/langerin+ rather than tryptase+.
CHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background.
These neoplasms show eosinophilia with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement, which can also contain spindled mast cells, so molecular testing is needed.

3676.recognize_zh: 低倍下一個骨髓顆粒（particle）內及周圍可見多顆大型、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞，數量明顯多於一般每個顆粒 1–3 顆，提示巨核細胞增多。
features: Low-power view of a cellular marrow particle with interspersed fat vacuoles
Multiple large megakaryocytes clustered within and at the edge of the particle
Megakaryocytes show abundant cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei; detailed nuclear morphology limited at this magnification
Background of peripheral blood red cells and scattered leukocytes around the particle
Individual megakaryocyte dysplasia cannot be assessed at this power
3676.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with admixed fat containing numerous megakaryocytes, several of which are clustered within and around the particle. The megakaryocytes appear large with abundant cytoplasm, though nuclear detail and dysplastic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryocytes; causes include peripheral platelet destruction (e.g., ITP), reactive thrombocytosis and myeloproliferative neoplasms, and correlation with platelet count and higher-power morphology is needed.

ddx.vs: Shows increased megakaryocytes that are morphologically normal or immature on high power with a low platelet count, so clinical correlation rather than this low-power view separates it.
Features large hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocytes in loose clusters on biopsy with thrombocytosis and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters of many smaller cells with high N:C ratio, rather than individual large cells with abundant granular cytoplasm.

3484.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色下，黏膜下擠在一起的多個結節整顆呈強棕色陽性，並向結節間延伸，而上方大腸黏膜與結節周圍纖維帶為陰性，這種凸顯腫瘤性濾泡的染色分布支持濾泡性淋巴瘤（標記名稱未標示）。
features: Low-power immunostain of the colonic polyp
Strong brown staining filling closely packed nodules throughout the submucosa
Positive cells also extend into interfollicular areas
Overlying colonic mucosa and fibrous septa largely negative
Specific antibody not stated; distribution suggests a B-cell or germinal-center marker
3484.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain shows strong positivity throughout the closely packed nodules that occupy the submucosa, with extension into the interfollicular regions. The overlying colonic mucosa and intervening fibrous bands are essentially negative. The antibody is not specified; the pattern of diffuse staining of crowded nodules is compatible with a germinal-center or B-cell marker (e.g., CD10 or BCL2) highlighting neoplastic follicles. In context, findings support follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: With BCL2, reactive germinal centers are negative while mantle zones and T cells stain; with CD10, staining is confined to germinal centers without interfollicular spread.
MCL nodules are CD10 negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, so a germinal-center marker would not highlight the nodules.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonizing MZL cells are CD10 and BCL6 negative, leaving residual follicles disrupted and only partially positive.

3484.stain: IHC: marker not specified (likely CD10 or BCL2)

3420.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：小腿與膝部皮膚散佈多發性紅紫色丘疹與斑塊，部分融合、表面有少許鱗屑或痂皮；在急性骨髓性白血病病人出現這類多發紅紫色皮膚病灶，應懷疑白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis），需切片確認。
features: Clinical photograph of the lower leg/knee region
Multiple scattered erythematous to violaceous macules, papules and small plaques
Some lesions coalesce into larger patches on the anterior shin
Occasional lesions show fine scale or small crusts; a few punctate purpuric dots
No ulceration or large nodules evident; histologic features cannot be assessed from a photograph
3420.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremity shows multiple scattered erythematous to violaceous macules, papules and small plaques over the knee and anterior shin, some coalescing and a few with fine scale or crusting. No ulcerated nodules are seen. The appearance is nonspecific clinically, but in a patient with acute myeloid leukemia it is suggestive of leukemia cutis; skin biopsy with immunohistochemistry (MPO, CD33, CD68, lysozyme, CD4, CD56) is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sweet syndrome lesions are tender edematous plaques whose biopsy shows mature neutrophils with papillary dermal edema rather than a blast infiltrate.
Vasculitis produces palpable purpura on biopsy showing fibrinoid vessel wall necrosis with neutrophilic nuclear dust, not dermal sheets of leukemic cells.

ddx.dx: Drug eruption or infection in neutropenic host
ddx.vs: Drug rashes and septic emboli are distinguished by histology and cultures, lacking MPO/CD33-positive myeloid infiltrates.
BPDCN presents with bruise-like violaceous skin nodules and the infiltrate is CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 positive and MPO negative.

3292.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中紅血球呈團塊狀，其間散布數顆比淋巴球大的單核細胞，核圓、細胞質中等量淡灰藍色，左下一顆細胞質有泡沫狀空泡，暗示為組織球（histiocyte）；但此倍率下難以確認細節。
features: Scattered large mononuclear cells, clearly larger than adjacent small lymphocytes
Round to oval, eccentric or central nuclei with fine chromatin
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm; one cell at lower left with foamy/vacuolated cytoplasm
Small dark lymphocytes interspersed for size comparison
Red cells aggregated into irregular clumps (thick area or preparation artifact)
3292.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear (thick area, with red cells aggregated into irregular clumps) shows several large mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate amounts of pale gray-blue cytoplasm, one of which contains foamy cytoplasmic vacuoles. Small lymphocytes are interspersed and provide a size reference. At this magnification the cells are suggestive of circulating histiocytes/macrophages, but nuclear and cytoplasmic detail is insufficient to exclude monocytes, plasma cells, or other abnormal cells; high-power review (ideally of a buffy coat preparation) is required.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded or kidney-shaped nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, and are usually smaller than activated histiocytes.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof.
Tumor cells show high N:C ratio, nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli and often cohesive clusters.
Endothelial cells are elongated with oval nuclei and occur in cohesive sheets from the needle tip rather than as isolated round cells.

3228.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一顆組織球的細胞質內包含多顆完整的橘紅色紅血球，右下另一顆大型組織球泡沫狀細胞質內含數個被吞噬的核碎片／有核細胞，符合噬血現象。
features: Histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing multiple intact orange-red erythrocytes
Histiocyte nucleus oval with fine chromatin, displaced by ingested cells
Second large histiocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed dense nuclear material (nucleated cells or apoptotic debris)
Background marrow with erythroid precursors and a fat space
Intact red cells indicate recent phagocytosis rather than hemosiderin
3228.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm containing multiple intact phagocytosed erythrocytes. A second, larger histiocyte displays vacuolated cytoplasm containing dense nuclear fragments consistent with engulfed nucleated cells or apoptotic debris. The surrounding marrow contains erythroid precursors and fat. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in the clinical setting of acute EBV infection, HLH should be evaluated using clinical and laboratory criteria, because morphologic hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage / apoptotic debris clearance
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages ingest apoptotic nuclear debris in proliferative states without engulfing intact erythrocytes.
Siderophages contain coarse golden-brown iron granules that are Prussian blue positive rather than intact red cells.
Storage cells have crinkled-paper or finely foamy cytoplasm without ingested erythrocytes or nucleated cells.
In erythroblastic islands nucleated erythroid precursors surround the central macrophage rather than being enclosed in its phagocytic vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in marrow biopsy — histiocytes containing intact erythrocytes and engulfed nuclear material (EBV setting)
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野兩種吞噬物：完整紅血球與核碎片；考官會問「哪一顆算 hemophagocytosis」，吞完整紅血球/有核細胞才算。
骨髓切片中組織球不易辨認，CD68 或 CD163 IHC 可突顯組織球與胞質內被吞細胞，增加噬血現象檢出。
HLH 實驗室：ferritin 顯著升高、sCD25 升高、高 TG、低 fibrinogen、肝功能異常；HScore 可估計 reactive HLH 機率。
成人 HLH 病因三大類：感染（EBV 最常見）、惡性腫瘤（lymphoma）、自體免疫（macrophage activation syndrome）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把吞核碎片的 tingible body macrophage 當成噬血；後者只清除 apoptotic debris，不吞完整紅血球。

quiz.q: 此切片中哪一種吞噬內容物才支持 hemophagocytosis？可用哪個 IHC 突顯組織球？
quiz.a: 完整紅血球或有核血球；CD68 或 CD163

3036.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個大型反應性淋巴球，細胞質豐富、呈淡藍至邊緣較深的嗜鹼性，輪廓不規則並被周圍紅血球擠壓出凹痕，核染色質較疏鬆，是傳染性單核球增多症常見的 Downey 型反應性淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte, about twice the diameter of surrounding RBCs
Abundant cytoplasm with pale blue center and deeper basophilia at the periphery
Irregular cytoplasmic outline with projections and indentation by adjacent RBCs
Round to oval nucleus with moderately condensed but less clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Normocytic, normochromic RBCs in background
3036.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large reactive lymphocyte with a moderate to low N:C ratio. The cytoplasm is abundant, pale blue with peripheral basophilia, and has an irregular outline that is indented by neighboring red cells. The nucleus is round to oval with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli. Background red cells are unremarkable. The cell is a reactive (atypical, Downey type II) lymphocyte, consistent with infectious mononucleosis when such cells are numerous.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and a folded or lobulated nucleus with lacy chromatin, without peripheral basophilia or RBC scalloping.
Blasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio, unlike this cell with abundant cytoplasm.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with CD103/CD25/CD11c positivity, rather than broad cytoplasm molded by RBCs.
Plasmacytoid cells have eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a perinuclear hof rather than a pale center with peripheral basophilia.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (Downey type II) lymphocyte of infectious mononucleosis — abundant cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia scalloped by adjacent red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆大細胞問名稱；答題關鍵字是「胞質邊緣較藍（peripheral basophilia）並被紅血球壓出凹痕（scalloping）」。
IM 血中的 reactive lymphocytes 主要是對抗 EBV 感染 B 細胞而活化的 CD8+ cytotoxic T cells，而非被感染的 B 細胞本身。
實驗室：heterophile antibody（Monospot）陽性；幼童常陰性，可改查 EBV VCA IgM、EBNA 抗體。
類 IM（heterophile-negative）鑑別：CMV、toxoplasmosis、acute HIV；年輕族群出現此抹片應考慮 HIV 篩檢。
臨床處置以支持療法為主，避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 monocyte 混淆；monocyte 胞質灰藍毛玻璃狀有細顆粒、核摺疊染色質疏鬆，reactive lymphocyte 則胞質清澈、邊緣嗜鹼並被紅血球壓凹。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質豐富、邊緣較藍並被紅血球壓出凹痕的細胞是什麼？在 IM 中它主要是哪一種免疫細胞？
quiz.a: Reactive（atypical, Downey type II）lymphocyte；CD8+ cytotoxic T cell

2780.recognize_zh: 高倍下生發中心內混合大型中心母細胞（泡狀核、明顯核仁）與中等大小中心細胞，並可見有絲分裂；左側為深染小淋巴球構成的套區。細胞組成多樣而非單一，支持反應性生發中心。
features: Mixed population of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Intermediate-sized centrocytes with irregular, cleaved nuclei
Occasional mitotic figure within the germinal center
Pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed histiocytes/dendritic cell nuclei
Sharp interface with a mantle of small round dark lymphocytes on the left
2780.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a germinal center composed of a heterogeneous mixture of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, intermediate cleaved centrocytes, and admixed histiocytes, with an occasional mitotic figure. It is bordered by a mantle of small, round, darkly staining lymphocytes. The cellular heterogeneity and zonation support a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a reactive germinal center within the marrow; BCL2 and light chain studies can be used if lymphoma is a concern.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are monotonous, lack tingible-body macrophages and a polarized mantle, and are BCL2-positive with t(14;18).
DLBCL shows sheets of uniformly large atypical cells without an organized mantle or mixed centrocyte population.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests of epithelial cells with keratin positivity, rather than a discohesive lymphoid population merging into a mantle zone.

2716.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中央一顆中型淋巴球，細胞質量多、淡藍色且邊緣不規則，形態接近大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte）；但此倍率下看不清嗜天青顆粒，單張圖也無法證明淋巴球增多。
features: Single medium-sized lymphocyte with moderate N:C ratio
Round-to-slightly irregular nucleus with condensed chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular outline; azurophilic granules not resolvable at this magnification
Segmented neutrophil at the field edge for size comparison
Background normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
2716.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells with adequate platelets. A single medium-sized lymphocyte with condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm is present centrally; cytoplasmic azurophilic granules cannot be resolved at this magnification. No blasts or atypical nucleolated cells are seen in this field. The image is compatible with a large granular lymphocyte in the setting of NK-cell lymphocytosis, but quantification and granule assessment require higher power and an absolute count, with flow cytometry to confirm NK phenotype.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical LGLs; separation requires flow cytometry (surface CD3+, CD8+, CD57+ in T-LGL versus CD3-, CD16+/CD56+ in NK) and TCR clonality studies.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells and usually lack azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with folded or lobulated nuclei, lacy chromatin, and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules.

2588.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆單核白血球旁邊有一小群大小一致的深藍色圓形球菌，排列成葡萄串狀（grape-like clusters），提示葡萄球菌菌血症；但細菌位於細胞外，須排除污染並以血液培養確認。
features: Cluster of uniform, small, round, dark-blue cocci arranged in grape-like groups
Organisms lie extracellularly adjacent to a leukocyte; no definite intracellular organisms in this cell
Mononuclear leukocyte with round nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
A few scattered single cocci elsewhere in the background
Thick area of smear with red cells aggregated in rouleaux-like sheets
2588.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with aggregated red cells, shows a cluster of uniform round, dark-staining cocci arranged in small grape-like clusters adjacent to a mononuclear leukocyte, with a few isolated cocci scattered nearby. The leukocyte has a round nucleus and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm and does not contain phagocytosed organisms. Because the bacteria are extracellular, contamination during collection or staining cannot be excluded on morphology alone. Findings are suggestive of staphylococcal bacteremia in the appropriate clinical setting; blood culture and Gram stain confirmation are required.

ddx.vs: Contaminants and precipitate are extracellular and often in variable focal planes, whereas true sepsis is supported by organisms phagocytosed within neutrophils and a positive blood culture.
Streptococci form pairs or chains rather than irregular grape-like clusters and are catalase negative.
Platelets are larger, irregular and granular with a pale hyalomere, while cocci are small, perfectly round and uniformly dense.

2524.recognize_zh: 一顆大型早期紅血球前驅細胞，核圓、染色質細顆粒狀，胞質深藍並有不規則突起（cytoplasmic bleb），可見早期紅系細胞；但本圖明確的發育不良特徵（如核出芽、多核）有限。
features: Large cell with a round nucleus and finely stippled to granular chromatin
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm, deepest at the periphery
Irregular cytoplasmic outline with a budding bleb at the lower edge
No definite nuclear budding, multinuclearity, or internuclear bridging
Background red cells and slide show a fine stippled artifact
2524.describe_en: Smear at high power shows a large early erythroid precursor, consistent with a proerythroblast or basophilic normoblast, with a round nucleus, finely stippled chromatin and intensely basophilic cytoplasm bearing an irregular cytoplasmic bleb. Definite dysplastic features such as nuclear budding, multinuclearity, internuclear bridging or megaloblastoid asynchrony are not clearly demonstrated in this single cell. The background shows a stippled artifact. The image fits an early erythroid precursor, but dyserythropoiesis cannot be firmly established from this field alone.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin in hemoglobinized cells, reversed by vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of such proerythroblasts, often vacuolated, comprising over 80% of cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts.
Parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts are giant cells with glassy intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic pseudopods in a marrow depleted of later erythroid forms.
Myeloblasts have paler blue cytoplasm without the intense basophilia, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD117 positive.

2140.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量高，可見許多胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞，混有大量小而深染的紅血球前驅細胞與少數粗顆粒的前驅細胞；在此倍率下看得出芽細胞增加與紅血球系增生，但細部發育不良需高倍確認。
features: Cellular aspirate with numerous blasts showing basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin
Many erythroid precursors including small, dense orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered granulated myeloid precursors, including a large cell with coarse granules (top center)
Occasional cells with abnormal nuclear shapes suggestive of dysplasia, not fully resolvable at this power
Abundant red cells in background
2140.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at medium power is cellular, with numerous blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm admixed with many erythroid precursors, including small dense late normoblasts, and scattered granulated myeloid precursors. A few cells show irregular nuclear contours suggestive of dysplasia, but detailed dysplastic features cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with a prominent erythroid component; classification as AML with myelodysplasia-related changes depends on blast count and multilineage dysplasia quantification.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts, erythroid-predominant
ddx.vs: Under current WHO criteria blasts are counted as a percentage of all nucleated cells; <20% blasts classifies as MDS rather than AML.
PEL requires >80% erythroid precursors with ≥30% proerythroblasts, not a mixture with myeloblasts.
Shows erythroid hyperplasia with megaloblastoid change but no increase in myeloblasts.

2076.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見成片大型細胞，核大於組織球核、呈卵圓形、染色質空泡狀（vesicular），多有明顯核仁與清楚核膜，細胞質中等量淡嗜酸性，呈瀰漫性排列，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with nuclei larger than histiocyte nuclei
Oval to round nuclei with vesicular chromatin, distinct nuclear membranes and one or several prominent nucleoli (some membrane-bound, some central)
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered small dark apoptotic or pyknotic cells
No residual normal lymphoid architecture visible in this high-power field
2076.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nuclear membranes, peripheral and central nucleoli, and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic cells are present, and no normal architecture is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, Ki-67, MYC/BCL2) is required to confirm B-cell lineage and exclude mimics.

ddx.vs: ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe-shaped nuclei and strong CD30 (±ALK) with T-cell markers, whereas DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5.
These can show cohesive nests and are cytokeratin or S100/SOX10 positive, while lymphoma is CD45 and B-cell marker positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with squared-off cytoplasm, starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement without BCL2 expression.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15 positive with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/CD45 in a mixed inflammatory background.

1884.recognize_zh: 抹片中只有一顆淡染、邊緣帶紫色顆粒狀沉積的單核細胞，細胞核輪廓不清；此圖單獨看無法確認毛狀細胞的毛狀突起，需配合標題與酸性磷酸酶（TRAP）或流式細胞儀判讀。
features: Single pale mononuclear cell roughly twice the size of adjacent red cells
Purple granular deposits concentrated at the cell periphery with sparse central granules
Nucleus poorly delineated; chromatin detail not assessable
No clearly defined circumferential hairy projections
Background red cells with slit-like central pallor (stomatocyte-like drying artifact)
1884.describe_en: Smear shows a single pale mononuclear cell with purple granular deposits concentrated at the periphery of the cytoplasm and a poorly delineated nucleus. Distinct hairy cytoplasmic projections are not evident, and the staining pattern raises the possibility of a cytochemical preparation rather than a routine Romanowsky stain. The surrounding red cells show slit-like central pallor, likely artifactual. Morphology in this single field is not diagnostic on its own; correlation with TRAP cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) is required to support hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: A degenerated basophil retains coarse metachromatic granules and a lobulated nucleus, whereas hairy cells have a round-oval nucleus with pale agranular cytoplasm and TRAP positivity.
Monocytes have a folded nucleus, gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules and are nonspecific esterase positive, CD14 positive and CD103 negative.
Villous lymphocytes show short polar villi with basophilic cytoplasm and are TRAP weak/negative, CD103 and annexin A1 negative.

1820.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片的大型組織球取代造血組織，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅並呈細纖維條紋狀，核小而偏位，左側僅殘存少量造血細胞，這是 H&E 染色下的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells）浸潤。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes replacing marrow hematopoietic tissue
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with fine fibrillary/striated texture
Small, bland, eccentric nuclei without significant atypia
Residual hematopoietic cells compressed at the left edge
Fat spaces present; no mitoses or necrosis seen
1820.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows extensive replacement of the marrow space by sheets of large histiocytes. The histiocytes contain abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with a fine fibrillary, striated texture and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoietic elements are confined to the periphery of the field, and there is no significant cytologic atypia or necrosis. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cell infiltration; enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Can look identical but occur in CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Striated histiocytes contain numerous acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Foam cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin and are associated with a light-chain-restricted lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher cell infiltration of marrow (H&E core) — sheets of large histiocytes with pale fibrillary/striated cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：切片版本考官問「造血組織被什麼取代？」答成片 Gaucher 細胞；在 H&E 下細胞質淡粉紅、帶細纖維條紋，與抹片的淡藍灰皺紙樣是同一種細胞。
切片輔助染色：PAS 陽性（抗 diastase）、CD68/CD163 陽性表巨噬細胞來源；抗酸染色排除 MAC。
大量浸潤可造成血球低下與骨病變，骨髓切片能評估浸潤範圍，但診斷仍需 glucocerebrosidase 活性與 GBA1 基因。
Gaucher 病患者罹患 multiple myeloma/MGUS 與 Parkinson disease 的風險增加，屬臨床常考關聯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為泡沫狀組織球（Niemann-Pick）或 MAC 感染；Niemann-Pick 細胞質為均勻小空泡泡沫狀，MAC 組織球條紋相似但抗酸染色可見大量桿菌。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片中成片纖維條紋狀細胞質的組織球，應加做哪個特殊染色排除分枝桿菌感染？
quiz.a: 抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen/AFB），排除 Mycobacterium avium complex 造成的 pseudo-Gaucher 細胞。

1628.recognize_zh: 這是免疫組織化學染色（紅色 AEC 呈色、蘇木紫複染），淋巴組織中成片中至大型細胞呈細胞膜/細胞質紅色陽性；圖上未標示抗體種類，無法單憑此圖判定是哪一群淋巴細胞，也無法確定是否為正常組織。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with red (AEC-type) chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain
Diffuse sheet of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei
Membranous and granular cytoplasmic red staining in the majority of cells
Staining relatively uniform across the field without clear zonation
Antibody not specified; architecture limited at this magnification
1628.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a red chromogen on lymphoid tissue shows a diffuse sheet of medium-to-large cells with round to oval nuclei, most of which show membranous and granular cytoplasmic positivity. No clear follicular or zonal pattern is evident in this high-power field. Because the antibody is not specified, the lineage of the positive cells cannot be determined from the image, and a uniformly positive population of larger cells would need to be correlated with the H&E and additional markers before interpreting it as normal (for example, a germinal center) versus a neoplastic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Reactive germinal center stained with a B-cell marker
ddx.vs: Would be a circumscribed nodule with a surrounding mantle and polarization, and a proliferation marker would show a high but zonated Ki-67.
Shows diffuse architectural effacement on H&E with sheets of large atypical B cells, often with aberrant marker expression.

ddx.dx: Paracortical T-zone stained with a T-cell marker
ddx.vs: Positive cells would be predominantly small lymphocytes admixed with negative interdigitating cells and high endothelial venules.

1628.stain: IHC: red chromogen, antibody not specified

60508.recognize_zh: 兩顆嗜中性球核分葉不足：上方為兩葉以細絲相連的低分葉核，下方為不分節、形狀不規則的團塊核，且兩者細胞質淡而顆粒稀少，符合治療後成熟中的異常嗜中性球。
features: Two neutrophils of mature size with abnormal nuclear segmentation
Upper cell: bilobed (hypolobated) nucleus with two dense lobes joined by a thin strand, pseudo-Pelger-like
Lower cell: non-segmented, irregular, folded nuclear mass with coarse clumped chromatin
Pale, hypogranular grey-pink cytoplasm in both cells
Background normocytic red cells; no promyelocytes, Auer rods or blasts in field
60508.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells and two neutrophils with abnormal nuclear morphology. The upper neutrophil has a hypolobated bilobed nucleus with lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand, and the lower neutrophil has an irregular, non-segmented, folded nucleus; both show coarse mature chromatin and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. No abnormal promyelocytes, Auer rods or blasts are present in this field. In the stated setting of ATRA/arsenic therapy for acute promyelocytic leukemia, findings are consistent with therapy-related maturation of leukemic cells into dysplastic-appearing neutrophils rather than a new myelodysplastic process.

ddx.vs: Morphology may be identical; the treatment history, transient nature (resolving within weeks) and absence of other dysplasia or MDS-defining genetics favor therapy effect.
The hereditary form affects virtually all neutrophils with normal granulation, unlike these hypogranular cells in a treated APL patient.
APL cells retain coarse azurophilic granules or Auer rods with less condensed chromatin, whereas these cells have mature clumped chromatin and sparse granules.

92.recognize_zh: 乳房植入物周圍積液抹片與纖維包膜內側，可見散在或成群的大型多形性細胞（核不規則、核仁明顯、偶見多核）；免疫染色 CD30 強陽性（膜及高基氏體點狀）、ALK 陰性、CD4/CD43 陽性但多數 T 細胞抗原喪失，符合 BIA-ALCL。
features: Large pleomorphic cells, several times the size of small lymphocytes, with abundant cytoplasm and variable N:C ratio
Irregular, indented to multilobated or horseshoe-like nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli; occasional multinucleated and mitotic cells

Cells lie singly and in loose cohesive-appearing clusters within fibrinous/necrotic exudate on the luminal side of a thick hyalinized fibrous capsule, without invasion through the capsule in the section shown
Mixed background of small lymphocytes and neutrophils in the Papanicolaou-stained fluid
IHC: CD30 strong membranous and Golgi-dot staining in large cells; ALK, CD20, CD3, CD5, CD7, CD8, TCR beta-F1 and TCR delta negative; CD4 and CD43 positive; CD2 weak partial; CD45 weak/partial
DUSP22 break-apart FISH: fused signals without split, i.e., no DUSP22 rearrangement
92.describe_en: Papanicolaou-stained seroma fluid shows numerous large pleomorphic cells with irregular, occasionally multilobated nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and abundant cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes and neutrophils; the cell block contains fibrin with scattered similar large atypical cells. Sections of the periprosthetic capsule show a thick hyalinized fibrous capsule lined on the luminal aspect by fibrinoid exudate containing clusters of large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and mitotic figures, confined to the luminal surface in the section shown. By immunohistochemistry the large cells are strongly and uniformly CD30 positive (membranous and Golgi pattern), CD4 and CD43 positive, weakly partially CD2 and CD45 positive, and negative for ALK, CD20, CD3, CD5, CD7, CD8, TCR beta-F1 and TCR delta, indicating a T-cell lineage with extensive antigen loss. DUSP22 break-apart FISH shows fused signals without rearrangement. Findings are consistent with breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK negative.

ddx.dx: ALK-negative systemic ALCL with secondary breast involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology and CD30+/ALK- phenotype overlap, so separation relies on clinical staging and the confinement of disease to the implant effusion/capsule.
Identical hallmark-type cytology, but ALK immunostaining is positive (nuclear and cytoplasmic with NPM1::ALK), whereas ALK is negative here.

Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+ but typically CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45 negative and lack CD4/CD43 T-cell expression, and occur as scattered cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets in a seroma.
Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin and GATA3 positive and CD30/CD4/CD43 negative, which excludes it in this immunoprofile.

92.stain: Papanicolaou, H&E, IHC panel, DUSP22 FISH
captions: Seroma fluid (Pap) with large pleomorphic cells, cell block low power, and cell block H&E high power
IHC: CD20 and CD3 negative in large cells, CD45 weak/partial, CD30 strongly positive, ALK negative

exam.answer_en: Breast implant-associated ALCL — large pleomorphic cells in peri-implant effusion and luminal capsule, uniformly strong CD30, ALK negative
pearls_zh: 考法：積液抹片指著大型多形、核仁明顯的細胞，問下一步要做什麼 IHC（CD30、ALK）與要不要看包膜是否穿透。
植入物置入多年後出現遲發性單側積液（seroma）是典型表現，主要與粗糙面（textured）植入物相關；積液應送細胞學、CD30 IHC 與流式。
表型：CD30 均勻強陽性（膜與高基氏體點狀）、ALK 陰性，T 細胞抗原多有喪失，常有 cytotoxic 標記表現。
侷限於積液或包膜內側者預後佳，治療以完整包膜切除並移除植入物為主；侵出包膜或形成腫塊才需全身治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 反應性積液中活化淋巴球也會 CD30 陽性，易過度診斷；反應性者散在、強度不一且大小混雜，BIA-ALCL 則為均勻強陽性的大型多形細胞。

quiz.q: 此病變的大細胞最關鍵的 IHC 組合為何？局限性病灶的主要治療是？
quiz.a: CD30 強陽性、ALK 陰性；完整包膜切除並移除植入物
